products.title: Marc-Antoine Barrois Ganyemede Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Marc-Antoine Barrois Ganymede Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that combines woody and spicy notes into a bold and modern scent. The perfume was introduced in 2019, and its top notes feature the lively and refreshing saffron and Italian mandarin, the soft heart of Chinese osmanthus, violet leaf and immortelle follows and at the same time the base is composed of the warm sensual notes of suede and human musk, cedar, patchouli and akigalawood, making it a versatile perfume that suits both day and night wearing.

products.title: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Royal Oud EDP is made for men and women. This perfume is a sophisticated perfume with a spicy and citrusy start moving into warm and woody middle notes and finishing with an elegant base. It opens with top notes of pink pepper, lemon and Sicilian bergamot which give a fresh and amazing impression. The middle notes of cedar, angelica and galbanum add a woody and green touch while the base of sandalwood, agarwood and musk leaves a smooth and long-lasting scent on skin and clothes.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Meteore Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Météore Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bright citrus perfume for men who like clean and powerful scents. The opening is full of juicy mandarin, Sicilian orange, and Calabrian bergamot, which is very sharp and fresh. The middle part of the perfume takes in Tunisian neroli along with spicy pink pepper, nutmeg, pepper, and cardamom that provide a warm spice kick. The base mostly consists of Java vetiver oil, which offers a clean, earthy aura and helps the fragrance to last on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance with a smooth and elegant oriental vanilla scent. Launched in 2021, it opens with fresh and spicy top notes of pink pepper and bergamot, followed by the floral heart of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and jasmine. The base is rich and warm with agarwood (oud), amber, and vanilla.

products.title: Lattafa Raghba Wood Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raghba Wood Intense Eau de Parfum is a strong oriental-woody scent made for men who enjoy deep, sweet, smoky perfumes. It starts with caramel, licorice, guaiac wood, and cedar. Then it develops in the direction of warm and sweet heart notes of oud, sugar, sandalwood and cashmere wood. The base is creamy and dense with incense, vanilla, amber, oakmoss and musk.

products.title: Lattafa Suqraat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Suqraat Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and slightly spicy men’s perfume from the house of Lattafa. It opens with bright bergamot and warm ginger, then moves into soft lavender and green violet leaf. The scent finishes with smooth musk, creamy sandalwood and a hint of warm amber.

products.title: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum is a warm, rich and sweet oriental scent made for both men and women. It combines bold spices with deep woods and smooth sweetness. The very beginning gives us saffron and bergamot, which form a brilliant start with a bit of spice. The heart is, of course, very powerful with oud and Bulgarian rose. Finally, the dry down is very warm and cozy with tonka bean, sugar cane, amber, white musk and oakmoss.

products.title: Bentley Silverlake Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and masculine fragrance that captures the spirit of adventure. Inspired by clear mountain air and sparkling lakes, this scent combines crisp citrus with cool aromatic notes, creating an energising and refreshing experience.

The fragrance opens with a shot of zesty lemon and cool mint, instantly boosting your freshness. At its heart, violet leaves, lavender, and pink pepper add a clean, slightly spicy, and green touch, making it both elegant and sporty. The base of white musk and amberwood brings a smooth, warm, and long-lasting finish.

Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum exudes a classy yet casual charm, perfect for the man who appreciates both sophistication and the great outdoors. One spray is like stepping into a crisp morning by a mountain lake, surrounded by fresh air and endless horizons.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Legere Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Légère Eau de Parfum is a modern, bold perfume for women. Launched in 2018, it is a lighter and fresher version of the original Good Girl, balancing sweet, floral, and warm notes perfectly. The fragrance opens with bright and fresh top notes of ylang-ylang, mandarin orange, bergamot, and lemon; the heart is full of floral beauty with tuberose, jasmine, orange blossom, and Bulgarian rose. The base adds depth with dulche de leche, praline, tonka bean, cinnamon, cashmerwood, sandalwood, musk, amber, patchouli, and cedar, leaving a warm, long-lasting trail.

products.title: Jo Malone Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne
products.body_html: Jo Malone Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne is a light and fresh perfume that gives a natural and soothing feeling. It starts off with a gentle salty wind that is blended with citrus, giving an overall clean and laid-back impression. As it gradually fades away, the sage scent adds a warm and comforting feeling through an earthy, herbal touch on the skin. The combination of ambrette and seaweed provides a soft, slightly musky foundation reminiscent of a stroll by the seaside. This fragrance is ideal for those who prefer refreshing, natural-scented perfumes.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum is the new-age scent of modern confidence. It’s a fragrance that celebrates being your true self, fresh, clean, and effortlessly stylish. Created for the man who is not afraid to show his sensitive side, this perfume beautifully combines bright citrus with a clean floral heart and a warm, woody base.

YSL Myslf is incredibly versatile and easy to wear. It’s the perfect companion for every part of your day, from a busy morning at the office to a relaxed evening with friends. A spray of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf feels like putting on your favorite crisp shirt, it gives you a boost of freshness and makes you feel put-together and ready for anything.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium is a daring and sweet scent for women that is contemporary and lively at the same time. The first notes come from the combination of pear, pink pepper, and orange blossom that gives a vivacious and sparkling impression, followed by a mellow heart of coffee and jasmine that feels warm, smooth, and slightly spicy. The foundation of vanilla, patchouli, and cedar gives a creamy, gentle, warm note that remains on the skin for hours. This perfume seems to be self-assured, powerful, and a good choice for women who are into sweet and evening scents.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Profumo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Profumo EDP for men is a deep smoky take on the fresh classic, opens with cool sea notes and sharp bergamot, heart brings rosemary sage geranium, base hits with incense and patchouli. Crafted by Alberto Morillas back in 2015. Fragrance fans rave about it as the grown-up version, richer, darker with that churchy incense twist, great projection sillage that turns heads.

products.title: Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: In the world of perfume, Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum is one of the certainly women's fragrances that are soft, fresh, and modern that smell clean and elegant. Fresh fruity accords of pear and citrus notes with their bright and smooth character immediately attract attention. Very gently, the white flowers likened to orange blossom and jasmine take the front, thus creating a creamy and feminine aura. At the end of the day, vanilla and amber bring in warmth and softness that remain on the skin for a long time. The whole fragrance is classy, soft, and ideal for everyday use.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Nuit de Feu Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Nuit de Feu Eau De Parfum is a deep and smoky unisex scent that feels warm, dark and very rich. The scent is characterized by very strong incense, leather, oud, olibanum, and musk notes, which altogether make up a bold fragrance that is sure to be remembered on the skin.

products.title: Louis Vuitton On The Beach Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton On The Beach Eau De Parfum is a fresh, bright and uplifting unisex scent inspired by warm sunshine and calm sea breeze. It mixes sparkling citrus with soft floral and warm herbal notes that feel clean, salty and smooth on the skin. The blend opens with juicy yuzu and sweet neroli, then moves into a warm mix of rosemary, thyme, sand, pink pepper and clove. The dry down settles nicely with cypress, giving a green and airy vibe that feels like standing close to the ocean shore.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Beach Walk Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Beach Walk Eau De Toilette is a soft, sunny and fresh scent that reminds you of a warm day at the beach. It opens with citrus notes, has a middle of creamy coconut and ends with a subtle musky base. The perfume has a very light, airy, and comfortable feel.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Parfum
products.body_html: Le Male Elixir Parfum is a warm, sweet and spicy take on the classic Le Male. It opens with fresh lavender and cool mint, then turns creamy with vanilla and benzoin in the middle, and settles into a cosy base of honey, tonka and tobacco. It feels rich, a bit sexy, perfect for evenings and cooler days, and stays close to the skin with a soft, warm trail.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Eau De Parfum is a rich and smooth unisex fragrance built around soft roses, warm oud and a sweet, creamy base. The scent opens with gentle Bulgarian rose, violet and a small sweet touch of strawberry. Then, the Turkish rose is delivered in the middle. Finally comes the burnished creamy mixture of oud, vanilla, amber, benzoin, caramel and cedar, which merges into a warm, silky, long-lasting scent that is somewhat sweet and very elegant.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, richer version of the original BR540. This perfume brings a warm, sweet and slightly spicy feeling with saffron, bitter almond, jasmine, cedar and strong ambergris tones. It feels smooth, bright and luxurious, with a soft woody and musky base that stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum is a bright, cheerful floral perfume for women who love sweet, joyful, and fresh fragrances. Inspired by the charm of blooming gardenia flowers, this perfume brings a burst of fruity sweetness with a soft floral heart that feels modern yet timeless.

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum is playful, feminine, and easy to wear every day. The scent opens with juicy red berries and pear blossom, adding a sparkling start. Then, the heart reveals creamy gardenia and jasmine that feel soft and romantic. Finally, a touch of sweet brown sugar and warm patchouli gives the fragrance a cozy, long-lasting finish. Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau De Parfum is like wearing a fresh flower crown, pretty, happy, and full of positive vibes.

products.title: Versace Eros Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Versace Eros Eau De Toilette is a bold, fresh, and sensual men’s fragrance inspired by Greek mythology and the god of love, Eros. This fragrance is designed for the strong, passionate man who lives life with confidence and desire.

The scent opens with a burst of cool mint, crisp green apple, and juicy lemon, giving an instant feeling of freshness and energy. The heart of Versace Eros Eau De Toilette adds warmth with sweet tonka bean, soft ambroxan, and aromatic geranium. In the base, rich Madagascar vanilla blends with strong cedarwood, vetiver, and oakmoss to create a masculine, long-lasting finish.

Versace Eros Eau De Toilette is the perfect choice if you want to feel powerful, attractive, and unforgettable.

products.title: Kayali Vanilla 28 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Vanilla 28 is a warm, sweet, and cosy fragrance that feels very smooth on the skin. The opening is soft vanilla orchid with a little bit of jasmine that feels gentle and creamy. Time passes and the smell becomes sweeter with the addition of brown sugar and tonka bean that create a deep and comforting sensation. The foundation is filled with amber, amberwood, musk, and patchouli, which provide a long-lasting warm glow that is very close to the skin. This scent is sweet, feminine, but also unisex, and thus it appeals to those who like soft and inviting, rich vanilla.

products.title: Premium Suede Pouch
products.body_html: Elevate your fragrance experience with the Scentira Suede Pouch, designed to store and protect your precious atomizer. Crafted from premium suede, this elegant pouch embodies sophistication and luxury. Its soft texture and refined appearance make it a perfect accessory for any perfume connoisseur. Safeguard your favorite scent with style and elegance.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Intense Eau De Parfum for Men, launched in 2019, is a modern, contemporary take on the classic Davidoff Cool Water DNA. It is a perfect mix of the zestiness of green mandarin as the top note, the creaminess of the coconut water as the heart note, and the warmth of amber as the base note. Cool Water Intense EDP came out as a way to enjoy a classic warm-weather, island-inspired fragrance without breaking your pocket.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Oud for Glory Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Oud for Glory Eau De Parfum is a strong and deep Arabic perfume made for both men and women who love rich oud scents. It starts with spicy and warm notes of saffron, nutmeg, and lavender, which make the fragrance bold right from the beginning. The main part of the perfume features soft patchouli and burnt agarwood (oud) giving the scent a dark and classy character. At last, the base of agarwood, patchouli, and musk come together in a very organic way, leaving behind a warm and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum is a warm, spicy, and irresistibly sweet unisex fragrance that is an oriental charm with a modern twist. Known for its rich cinnamon and vanilla profile, Khamrah is a bold scent inspired by Arabian traditions and global luxury tastes. Often compared to high-end niche perfumes, Lattafa Khamrah offers an affordable alternative without compromising on quality or performance. This perfume is ideal for people who enjoy strong, lasting fragrances with a warm, dessert-like aroma.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau De Parfum is a fresh and aromatic perfume for men. Launched in 2023, it opens with a burst of fruity and citrus notes of apple, Italian lemon, Sicilian bergamot and star anise. The middle contains majesty plum, orange blossom and cardamom, giving a sweet and spicy impression, while the base leaves a warm musk, amber, driftwood and moss trail that is long lasting.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum is a strong and sweet scent for men that gives a feeling of luxury and elegance. The spicy opening with cumin and cardamom is rich and a bit refreshing at the same time. Little by little, the gentle rose and powdery orris appear and smoothen out the fragrance. Finally, vanilla, amber, and woods create a soft and very persistent end. This perfume is strong, masculine, and an ideal choice for the self-assured man.

products.title: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy fragrance for the modern man. The fragrance begins with the very lively and vibrant top notes of tomato leaf, rose and freesia. It then transforms into a floral and woody heart of rose, sandalwood, cedar and jasmine. Finally, it wraps up with a base that provides a rich and warm finish through the combination of leather, oud, musk, oakmoss and amber.

products.title: Acqua Di Parma Ginepro Di Sardegna Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Perfumer Mélanie Carestia formulated Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo – Ginepro di Sardegna Eau de Toilette for men and women in 2014 starting with a base of Virginia Ceder, a heart of clean and green sage and cypress mixed with a twist of spicy and citrusy accords of Juniper, pepper, allspice, nutmeg, bergamot. It is widely recognized as “Most Sensual Acqua di Parma Perfume with Juniper” by fragrance enthusiasts and has been ranked among the Top Blu Mediterraneo fragrances.

products.title: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette is a fresh, soft, and very feminine perfume made for women who love light and clean scents. It opens with a fresh mix of yuzu and pomegranate that feels juicy and bright. Slowly, the floral heart of peony, lotus, and magnolia comes out and feels smooth and gentle. The base of musk and amber gives a soft warmth that stays close to skin. This perfume feels elegant, fresh, and perfect for daily wear.

Burberry Goddess Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Goddess EDP Spray is a gourmand aromatic fragrance for women, launched in 2023. The fragrance stands out with a triple vanilla infusion, offering a warm and creamy sweetness to the overall scent. The fresh herbal touch of lavender adds to the depth and complexity of the fragrance and makes it suitable for colder seasons of the year or special occasions.

products.title: Nishane Hacivat Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Nishane Hacivat Extrait De Parfum is a bold and bright unisex fragrance that stands out for its fruity and woody character. Launched in 2017 by the talented perfumer Jorge Lee, this perfume opens with fresh and zesty pineapple, grapefruit and bergamot notes. The middle notes consist of cedar, patchouli and jasmine, which give the fragrance a smooth and elegant scent. Finally, the base comprised of oakmoss and woody notes provides an enduring, warm and versatile finish that is suitable for all occasions.

products.title: Frederic Malle Portrait Of A Lady Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Frederic Malle Portrait Of A Lady Eau De Parfum is an elegant and bold fragrance created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion in 2010. It’s a timeless perfume that captures grace, mystery, and confidence in every spray. The fragrance opens with rich and spicy top notes of rose, clove, cinnamon, black currant, and red berries. The heart unfolds with Turkish rose, patchouli, incense, sandalwood, and ylang-ylang, blending beautifully into a deep and sensual base of musk, amber, benzoin, cedar, ambergris, vanilla, and incense.

products.title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum is a bold and fresh men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Bvlgari. Launched in 2016, this perfume is inspired by the power of the Tiger’s Eye stone, symbolising strength and confidence. The fragrance opens with the brightness of grapefruit, combining into spicy and musky tones of ginger and ambrette, and settles into a smooth base of ambroxan, musk, vetiver, and patchouli. A perfect scent for men who love a fresh, strong, and modern aroma.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim Eau De Parfum is a bright, juicy and refreshing citrus scent made for people who love clean and energetic summer perfumes. It opens with a strong blast of mandarin and orange that feels like fresh sunshine on skin. The bergamot adds a soft sparkle, while ginger and ambergris give it a warm, salty, slightly sweet twist that dries down clean.

products.title: Givenchy L'interdit Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum for women is a bold, elegant, and modern floral perfume that brings a creamy white floral vibe with a warm and slightly dark twist. It opens with juicy pear and fresh bergamot, then moves into a rich mix of tuberose, jasmine sambac, and orange blossom for a bright and feminine floral heart. The base offers patchouli, vanilla, vetiver, and ambroxan, giving the scent a soft creamy finish with a deep warm touch.
This perfume is loved for its classy feel, long lasting performance, and confident aura that makes it perfect for women who like to stand out in a graceful way.

products.title: Prada Candy Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Candy Eau De Parfum is a lovely, warm, and, in fact, very irresistible women’s fragrance. It starts with a deep caramel note that is very smooth and at the same time very tasty, even from the first spray. Gradually, hints of powdery notes and soft musk come very subtly and the fragrance feels more and more like a warm cocoon around women. The rich and deep base of vanilla and benzoin provides the lingering warmth and depth that lasts for hours and hours. This perfume has an aura of playfulness, elegance, and is definitely for women who adore sweet scents.

products.title: Paco Rabanne One Million Royal
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne One Million Royal is a sophisticated fragrance featuring fresh, spicy, and woody notes, designed for independent men. It begins with a lively combination of cardamom, tangerine, and bergamot that is distinctly clean and vibrant. The heart note comes through with very mild lavender and sage along with a hint of green from violet leaf. The base note is created by benzoin, cedar, and patchouli which contribute the warmth and the depth effect. This perfume has a very modern, elegant, and daring character, which makes it wonderful for everyday use and nightlife as well.

products.title: Orto Parisi Megamare Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Orto Parisi Megamare Extrait De Parfum is an invigorating and oceanic fragrance. Its top notes consist of a sparkling bergamot and lemon that are bright, clean, and lively, and then the heart of the scent takes you to the beach with seaweed, calone, and hedione that have a watery, marine quality. Musk, ambroxan, and cedar form the base of the perfume that is gentle, velvety, and durable. This fragrance gives the impression of being refreshing, contemporary, and suitable for lovers of water and fresh air scents from nature.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Ombre Nomade Eau De Parfum is a dark, rich and deep unisex perfume. It is known for its strong oud, smoky incense and warm amber wood feel that stays long on the skin. The scent opens with a mix of sweet raspberry and saffron, then melts into rose and smoky incense and finally settles into heavy agarwood that gives a strong touch.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Imagination Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Imagination Eau De Parfum is a bright and modern citrus aromatic scent made for men who like fresh, clean and a bit warm type perfumes. The aroma begins with a silky blend of citron, bergamot, and orange, then transitions to soft neroli, spicy ginger, and cinnamon which feels warm but still fresh. The lower notes are stronger with Chinese black tea, ambroxan, guaiac wood, and olibanum that remain on the skin for a long time and impart a luxurious and soothing aura.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Toilette is a beautiful scent in the Woody Floral Musk group, made to capture a feeling of peaceful, quiet calm and easy elegance. It starts with a citrusy smell of Mandarin. The middle of the scent moves into a smooth, dry softness, where the gentle touch of White Tea is nicely lifted by the soft, almost powdery feel of Iris and a light, green herb note. The final part rests on a comforting, skin-close foundation: three quiet Musks blend with warm, comforting Madras Wood and Ambrette Seed, creating a subtle, lasting fragrance that feels polished and lovely for wearing every day.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum was launched in 1999. This citrus aromatic fragrance for women is an absolute favourite of working and easy-going women. Francis Kurkdijian is the perfumer behind this absolute fragrance. The top notes of this scent include Lemon, Bergamot, Mint, Orange Peel and Rhubarb. While the heart tones and the dried tones include Jasmine, Musk, Oakmoss, Fennel, Carnation, White Amber, Musk, Oakmoss, Celery Seeds, Caraway, Cloves and Amber.

products.title: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau De Parfum is a calm, woody, and comforting unisex fragrance that brings to mind the peaceful beauty of sandalwood forests. Inspired by the mountains of Tonkin in Vietnam, this perfume is a tribute to sacred woods and age-old traditions. Tam Dao is simple yet rich, perfect for those who love warm, woody, and smooth scents with a soft floral base. Tam Dao is ideal for people who prefer minimalism in scent – smooth, clean, and soothing.

products.title: Billie Eilish No. 1
products.body_html: Billie Eilish No. 1 Eau de Parfum is the first fragrance by Billie Eilish. It is warm, sweet and slightly spicy, wrapped around soft vanilla and cacao. The perfume opens with sugar, red berries and mandarin orange that feel bright and sweet. The heart brings in a smooth combination of vanilla, cacao, rose, and a hint of spice. The base is cosy with amber, tonka bean, musk, and woody notes that stay close to the skin. It feels sensual, sweet, and comforting, just like Billie wanted it to be.

products.title: Amouage Interlude Man Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Interlude Man is not just a perfume; it's a statement. Famously known as the "Blue Beast," this fragrance captures a moment of beautiful chaos in a bottle.It is a powerful, bold, and artistic masterpiece designed for the man who is confident and unafraid to stand out.

The scent is a masterful dance between spicy warmth and smoky depth. It smells like a cool, starry night warmed by a sophisticated campfire, with sweet incense smoke swirling in the air. Amouage Interlude Man is for those who appreciate luxury and complexity. A spray of this iconic blue bottle promises an unforgettable experience, wrapping you in an aura of mystery, power, and pure class.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men is a fresh, modern, and confident fragrance that balances crisp freshness with deep woody notes. Inspired by the spirit of the contemporary man who dares to dream, this scent embodies boldness, freedom, and a touch of class.

The opening is refreshing, featuring juicy apple, spicy ginger, and zesty bergamot. In the heart, Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men brings aromatic sage, vibrant geranium, and juniper berries, giving it a green yet slightly floral twist. The base notes wrap you in warm amberwood, smooth tonka bean, rich cedar, vetiver, and olibanum, creating a long-lasting masculine trail.

Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men is perfect for those who love versatile, everyday scents with a signature edge. One spray is enough to make you feel fresh, stylish, and ready to conquer your day.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Eau De Parfum is the definition of class and sophistication in a bottle. Inspired by the iconic YSL tuxedo suit, this fragrance is for anyone who wants to feel confident, elegant, and effortlessly stylish. It perfectly blends the boldness of spicy patchouli with the warmth of smooth vanilla, creating a scent that is both powerful and comforting.

Tuxedo smells like a luxurious night out. It has a modern yet timeless charm that makes you feel polished and ready for any special occasion. It’s the perfect fragrance for those who love rich, attractive scents that draw compliments and leave a lasting memory. One spray of YSL Tuxedo wraps you in an aura of pure elegance.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum is a daring and opulent scent for women that appears to be a rich blend of warm and mildly sweet. Initially, it shows the fresh explosion of ginger, saffron, and citrus notes that provide a spicy and exhilarating start. The middle of orange blossom and lavender contributes a delicate and floral scent, while the bottom of bourbon vanilla, honey, tonka bean, and vetiver gives a creamy and very lasting smelly cloud. This perfume smells contemporary, assertive, and suitable for the ladies who enjoy warm and classy scents.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L’Homme Eau De Toilette is a dark, attractive, and classy men’s fragrance that feels smooth and spicy. It starts with an aroma of cardamom that is fresh and spicy at the same time; this note feels warm and a little sweet. Gradually, lavender and bergamot introduce a soft and clean aspect while cedar provides a woody impression. The foundation of vetiver and caraway renders the fragrance rich and sensual. This perfume gives off a vibe of confidence, romance, and it’s just right for men who prefer calm yet strong scents.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Intense Eau De Parfum is a woman's fragrance with deep, warm, and bold notes; it feels rich and addictive. The fragrance opens with a dark fruity note that is slightly fresh and then gradually moves into a strong coffee heart combined with white flowers. The base is sweet and creamy with vanilla and soft woods that linger on skin for a long time. This fragrance feels sexy, confident, and is just right for night wear and special occasions.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum is a classy and modern women’s fragrance that feels fresh, soft, and slightly sweet. It opens with a clean lavender and juicy orange feel that smells bright and confident. Slowly, white flowers like orange blossom and jasmine come out and feel smooth and feminine. The vanilla and musk base makes it warm and long lasting. This scent feels elegant, bold, and perfect for confident women.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum is the ultimate expression of modern masculinity, confidence, and success. This fragrance is a deep, intense, and incredibly smooth take on the iconic Y signature. It masterfully balances vibrant freshness with a powerful, dark elegance, creating a scent that is both bold and sophisticated.

Y Le Parfum smells like ambition in a bottle. It opens with a fresh burst of crisp apple and zesty grapefruit, then settles into a clean, aromatic heart of lavender and sage. The real magic happens in the base, where warm tonka bean and rich woods provide a deep, long-lasting trail that feels luxurious and powerful. It’s the perfect fragrance for the man who is bold, ambitious, and carves his path.

products.title: Xerjoff Naxos Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Xerjoff Naxos Eau De Parfum is a vibrant and sweet unisex scent that has the character of being warm and rich. The opening is marked by radiant lemon, bergamot, and lavender notes that are both fresh and spirited. The creamy, warm, and sugary heart created by honey, cinnamon, jasmine, and cashmeran is present in the fragrance. The soft, lingering heat produced by the combination of vanilla, tonka bean, and tobacco leaf is the foundation. This perfume has a character that is chic, contemporary, and fit for all, especially the ones who adore sweet and bold scents.

products.title: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme Eau De Parfum is a daring and strong fragrance for men with a dark and spicy character. The perfume is very warm and feels quite powerful. It starts with a blast of spicy notes that are sharp and hot, and then, with time, the scent turns into a huge and deep one with warm spices and smooth woods. The whole scent is powerful, male-oriented and very self-assured. The fragrance is for those men who enjoy and can withstand the power of the scent of strong and spicy perfumes that last long and can be exhibited during cold seasons.

products.title: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau De Parfum is a fiery and daring scent for men that is characterized by its spicy, smoky and powerful facets. The first impression is a very strong one of cinnamon and chili pepper that feels warm and adrenaline-pumping. Gradually, the rich leather note reveals itself and adds a dark, manly aspect. The woodsy and resinous base is smooth and lingers on the skin for a long time. This scent exudes power, confidence and is definitely for men who are fond of strong perfumes.

products.title: Victoria's Secret Tease Creme Cloud Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Victoria's Secret Tease Crème Cloud Eau De Parfum is an exquisite, gentle, and sugary perfume that is specifically designed for the women who are fond of soft and warm scents. The fragrance has a beginning which is a silky and luscious combination of vanilla and meringue that gives a feeling of sugar and comfort. The fragrance then moves to the heart of soft sandalwood which imparts a milky touch while the base and musk are laced with amber to provide warmth and make the scent last longer. The perfume has a very clean and sweet quality and is extremely soothing, perfect for daily use.

products.title: Victoria's Secret Bombshell Sundrenched Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Victoria's Secret Bombshell Sundrenched Eau De Parfum is a sunny and fresh fragrance designed for women who are into delicate and beachy aromas. It gives off a light warm and very pleasant feeling. The perfume starts off with fresh and floral notes, and then gradually becomes a bit tropical and creamy. Finally, it leaves a sandy and hygienic trail on the skin. This fragrance is ideal for summer days, vacations, and informal occasions.

products.title: Victoria's Secret Bombshell Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Victoria's Secret Bombshell Eau De Parfum is a lovely mixed scent of fruits, flowers, and air that is characteristic of women who enjoy bright and assured aromas. It begins with citrus trees and their fruits like passionfruit, grapefruit, and strawberry that are in a fresh, sweet state. In due time, the gentle floral notes of peony and jasmine gradually emerge, thus giving the fragrance the attributes of being female and silky. The underlying tone consists of musk and wood that cling to the skin and clothing for hours on end. This perfume gives an impression of being sexy, joyous, and young thus being suitable for everyday use and also for special occasions.

products.title: Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is a bold, fresh, and sensual men’s fragrance inspired by the Greek god of love Eros. Just like its name, this perfume is all about passion and power. It opens with an amazing blast of mint, sweet candy apple, and zesty citrus fruits. As it settles, warm ambroxan and fresh geranium add depth and masculinity. Finally, a smooth blend of vanilla, cedar, and leather wraps you in a warm, confident finish.

Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is perfect for modern men who want to feel strong, attractive, and unforgettable. A few sprays will boost your confidence and turn heads wherever you go.

products.title: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Flame Eau De Parfum is an intense and warm men's fragrance that is characterized by spicy, sweet, and woody notes. The beginning is a very fresh and bold combination of mandarin, lemon, and spicy pepper that is very vigorous. Gradually, the aroma gets softer with delicate blossoms and wood. Eventually, a heavier, warm feeling is produced by the vanilla, tonka bean, and sandalwood in the base. This fragrance emanates power, self-assuredness, and is spot-on for today’s men.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum is a creamy, luscious and sophisticated scent for women that is utterly warm and enigmatic. The fragrance begins with a peppery the spicy touch of ginger, and cardamom that is bold and rich. Bit by bit, the gentle notes of coconut, gardenia, and orange blossom are revealed and they make the fragrance smooth and feminine. At the end, sandalwood, musk, and amber provide an elegant and enduring finish. This fragrance is characterized by sensuality, self-assurance, and suitability for special occasions.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Valentino Uomo Eau De Toilette is a fragrant men's perfume that smells clean and classy with a fresh and woody vibe. It starts off with citrusy notes of bergamot and lemon which are very fresh and smooth. After a while, the iris and vetiver join in and impart a gentle, powdery, and earthy vibe. The foundation of cardamom and black pepper gives a subtle spice which is both manly and sophisticated. This fragrance gives off a tranquil, fashionable, and everyday friendly aura.

products.title: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum For Women
products.body_html: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum for Women is a deep, warm, and elegant perfume which was made for the ladies who are self-assured. To begin with, there is a fragrant mixture of vanilla and amber which is strong, sweet and daring. The mid of the perfume consists of the gentle scent of jasmine that gives a delicate touch of flowers. The end notes are the warm and comforting ones which make the scent last for a long time and suit night, parties and special occasions.

products.title: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Eau De Parfum is a women's fragrance that is gentle but at the same time daring, it is elegant and modern at the same time. The top notes are a fresh and somewhat spicy combination of black currant and pink pepper that is bright and cheerful. The heart gradually gives way to the flower notes and among them are the most wonderful jasmine notes that are pure and graceful. The base consists of warming, smoothing bourbon vanilla and gentle woods that linger on the skin for hours in a very subtle way.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Eau De Toilette is a men’s perfume that is fresh and spicy with a modern and clean vibe. The top notes are quite cool and include a combination of mineral notes, violet leaf, and a little bit of salt that is very fresh and original. In the heart, sage mixed with ginger contributes a spicy and a bit warm sensation. The woody notes and vetiver in the base create a dry, manly finish. This fragrance is fashionable, assertive, and suitable for everyday use.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum is a bold, sensual, and modern fragrance for men who want to stand out. Inspired by the Roman nights, this perfume celebrates confidence, style, and the rebellious spirit of Rome.

Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense starts with a sweet and creamy vanilla note that feels warm and inviting. A touch of fresh lavender in the heart keeps it classy and smooth. The base of vetiver adds a deep, masculine, and elegant finish that stays on the skin for hours.

This perfume is intense but easy to wear. It's perfect for men who want to feel confident and attractive on special occasions or romantic dates. A few sprays of Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum will make you feel powerful and stylish, ready to own the night.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: The Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Eau De Toilette is a fragrance for men that has a fresh, woody, and slightly spicy scent, and it is modern at the same time. The very first notes of the fragrance are an appealing combination of juicy red apple, cardamom, and bergamot, which are thoroughly delightful and full of liveliness. The heart of the fragrance is clean and very aromatic; it is composed of lavender, geranium, and sage. The base notes are tobacco leaf, patchouli, and vetiver that provide warmth and depth to the fragrance. The fragrance mainly reflects a fashionably young and daring personality, thus making it suitable for everyday wear and informal gatherings.

products.title: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum is a sumptuous, sugary, and elegant perfume for women that has a warm, and luxurious feeling. The top notes are represented by a delicate and mellow combination of honey, rum, and citrus that is soft and welcoming. The floral part is composed of orchid, jasmine, rose, and magnolia and makes the scent feel like its melting and softening into a woman. The warm notes of vanilla, sandalwood, and suede are the last to be felt and give depth and long-lasting warmth to the scent. This perfume feels to be the combination of elegance, audacity, and the best choice for women who are confident.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum is a very masculine perfume that is rich, warm, and creamy and at the same time it is classy and bold. Its first impression comes with a spicy aroma of cardamom and saffron which has a mixed taste of sweet and sharp at the same time. Then the cardamom and saffron gradually fade away into a creamy kulfi and a floral heart which is smooth and special. The base composed of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood gives the fragrance a deep and a very long-lasting quality. This perfume is for the self-confident man who is also luxurious and wants to be perfect for extraordinary occasions.

products.title: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Eau De Parfum is a clean, fresh and classy men’s perfume from the house of Tom Ford. It is the sharp citrus beginning, spicy heart and smooth woody base that makes this perfume stand out among and an unpolished look and elegant feel of a man who wears it. The note of the vetiver continuously spreads its presence and gives a dry, earthy and confident aura during the entire wear of this perfume.

products.title: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Parfum is a fresh yet deep unisex perfume inspired by the calm and wild Mediterranean coast. It opens with a bright and natural wave of Italian lemon that is very pleasant. It gradually transitions into green woody aromas of cypress and oak, creating a coastal forest scene. The base of amber and labdanum foundation imparts a mellow and smooth depth that is relaxed but upscale, so it can be worn daily with ease.

products.title: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Parfum is a bold, dark and rich women’s perfume. Black Orchid was launched in 2006 and was created by David Apel and Pierre Negrin. It opens with deep and slightly sweet notes that feel warm and luxurious. As it settles, floral and spicy tones come out slowly and smoothly. The base feels creamy, chocolatey and woody, which stays on the skin for long hours.

products.title: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau De Parfum is an exquisite and elegant unisex fragrance that has a woody character. It is warm and soft, and very luxurious, right from the first application. The fragrance starts off with delicate spices and rosewood that are both clean and rich. Gradually, the oud and sandalwood appear, creating a profound woody sensation. During the dry down, tonka bean and amber provide a gentle and prolonged sweetness. This perfume feels luxurious, serene, and self-assured, ideal for the customers of high-end fragrances.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ombré Leather Parfum is an intense, velvety, and daring leather fragrance that exudes sophistication and luxury. It starts with a delicate green hint of violet leaf and dry cedar, then gradually transitions to a pure floral heart with jasmine and orris. The foundation is a blend of leather, wood notes, and a faintly tobacco-like smell, which are all three very strong. This fragrance gives off a powerful, self-assured, and contemporary vibe which is ideal for those who are fans of leather perfumes with a strong presence.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum is an impressive, smooth, and elegant leather fragrance which has a rich and profound character. It starts with the spicy touch of cardamom, which is at once fresh and a little warm. In no time, strong leather notes along with soft jasmine give a powerful yet clean impression. Deep and long-lasting scent is achieved by the combination of amber, moss, and patchouli at the base. The fragrance strikes as being steadfast, contemporary, and fashionably, ideal for those who appreciate powerful and elegant scents.

products.title: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau De Parfum is a powerful and daring leather scent that gives the impression of being luxurious, dark and elegant. The beginning of the fragrance is a little fruity with the raspberry combined with the saffron, which gives the impression of being a bit sweet and spicy. Gradually, it goes to the smoky and floral heart that feels deep and smooth. The base is all leather and suede, and it is warm, powerful, and long-lasting. This perfume is confident, mature, and luxurious, and it is ideal for bold fragrance lovers.

products.title: Tiffany & Co. Tiffany Eau De Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Tiffany & Co. Tiffany Eau De Parfum Intense is a rich and elegant floral women’s perfume who love classy and soft luxury. It opens fresh and bright, then slowly turns creamy, floral and slightly sweet on the skin. The scent starts with juicy pear, pink pepper and green mandarin leaf that feels fresh but smooth. In the middle, iris stands out beautifully with jasmine and rose, offering it a clean and powdery floral touch. The base is warm and comforting with vanilla, musk, amber, benzoin and cashmeran, making it last long and feel very cozy.

products.title: Mugler Alien Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mugler Alien Eau De Parfum is a bold, warm and mysterious women's perfume for those who love a strong presence. It starts off with a very intense jasmine scent that feels very creamy and floral upon the first spray. As it develops, delicate woody notes begin to come out and provide the scent with a deep and soothing quality. The dry down is smooth, very amber-like and lasts a long time, which makes Alien a signature scent for a lot of women.

products.title: Scent Story 24 Gold Oud Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Scent Story 24 Gold Oud Eau De Toilette is a bold, warm and rich unisex perfume made for people who love strong woody scents. The scent opens with the spicy notes of the hot and lively feel, then gradually intermingles with a warm and deep woodiness and increasingly comes on to a sweet, smoky oud base. The fragrance is still smooth on the skin and feels luxurious and powerful. Perfect if you are a fan of oud combined with spices and soft sweetness. The musk feels modern but has a slight Arabic like touch, making it suitable for both men and women.

products.title: Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina Ribelle Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina Ribelle Eau De Parfum is a bold, sweet and modern fragrance made for confident women. A top note of the fragrance is a lively combination of pink pepper and sweet mandarin, which is very fresh and even fun-like. This is followed by a moderate flowery mixing of frangipani and ylang-ylang that gives the perfume a rich and lovely aspect. The base note is what really steals the show as it features a mixture of nice ice cream, coconut milk and vanilla, making the perfume warm, smooth and slightly addictive.

products.title: Salvatore Ferragamo Black Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Salvatore Ferragamo Black Pour Homme Eau De Toilette is a bold and classy men’s perfume from the luxury Italian house of Salvatore Ferragamo. Launched in 2009, this scent is known for its clean yet spicy character that feels confident and modern. At first, the scent reveals brisk lavender and succulent apple, thereby giving a smooth and slightly sweet beginning. Then the middle gets filled with hot black pepper as well as coriander, which contribute their own nuances of warmth and richness. Finally, the tonka bean and labdanum form the base, which results in the fragrance being creamy, soft and masculine.

products.title: Rasasi Qasamat Bareeq Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Qasamat Bareeq Eau De Parfum is a modern and lavish unisex fragrance that characterizes the house of Rasasi. It has clean and bright citrusy and fruity notes that come through fresh and a bit green. The scent, as it matures, gives off warmth, softness, spices, sweetness and a little floral fragrance. The base is strong and gentle with some leather, musk, woods and earth notes that last on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Rasasi Nafaeis Al Shaghaf Pour Femme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Nafaeis Al Shaghaf Pour Femme Eau De Parfum from Rasasi is a fragrance for women who love warm and creamy scents. The perfume is soft, sweet and elegant. The fragrance starts with a warm mix of almond, lemon and coffee that is creamy and slightly sweet. The middle turns floral with jasmine, tuberose, iris and lily, giving it a rich and feminine touch. The dry down reveals a warm and soft base consisting of vanilla, musk, sandalwood and amber, which is quite close to the skin and very satisfying. This perfume is simple, classy and easy to wear for daily use as well as special moments.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a bold and deep leather-based fragrance made for men who like strong and confident scents. It gives a slightly sweet and spicy impression from raspberry and saffron at the start, combined with a dry herbal sensation. The fragrance develops a smoky and warm character in the middle, while the base is formed of rich leather, plush suede and earthy notes with delicate amber.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Eau De Parfum For Men
products.body_html: Hawas for Him by Rasasi is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Hawas for Him was launched in 2015. Top notes are Apple, Bergamot, Lemon and Cinnamon; middle notes are Watery Notes, Plum, Cardamom and Orange Blossom; base notes are Ambergris, Musk, Patchouli and Driftwood.

products.title: Rasasi Fattan Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Fattan Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a fresh, green and woody men's perfume who like clean and earthy scents. The perfume starts with very citrusy notes that are sharp, fresh and brightly lit. Later on, the scent gradually goes through to a very vetiver heart. The warm, slightly sweet and mossy base makes the classiness and the naturalness of the fragrance even more pronounced. Fattan is a perfume that attracts a lot of men who love fresh, modern and outdoor type fragrances.

products.title: Prada La Femme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Prada La Femme Eau De Parfum is a gentle, graceful fragrance for ladies that is characterized by its creaminess, floralness, and sophistication. The fragrance starts with a soft combination of magnolia and bergamot that is fresh, smooth, and a little bit powdery. Gradually, the strong white flowers such as tuberose, frangipani, and ylang-ylang are revealed, creating a warm and womanly atmosphere. The comfort, cleanliness, and durability of the scent coming from the base of vanilla, beeswax, and vetiver make it ideal for daily elegance.

products.title: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau De Toilette is a contemporary men's fragrance that is fresh, clean, and modern with a smooth and energetic feel. The top notes are a bergamot and pink pepper freshness that is cool and purifying. The middle notes consist of soothing and somewhat powdery lavender, iris, and sage. In the base, musk and caramel impart gentle sweetness along with the richness of wood. The fragrance is sophisticated, fresh, and ideal for everyday use.

products.title: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau De Parfum is an elegant men's scent that is dark, smooth, and modern. The fragrance starts off with a refreshing note of bergamot that is clean and sharp, but it later mixes with gentle angelica and deep patchouli. In the end, amber, musk, and coumarin create a dark, slightly sweet, and warm scent. This fragrance is self-assured, relaxed, and fashionable, which is why it is ideal for men who prefer classy and strong scents.

products.title: Prada L'homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Prada L’Homme Eau De Toilette is an inviting, subtle, and sophisticated scent for men that exudes freshness and class. It starts off with a gentle and bright soft blend of neroli and pepper. Gradually, the heart delivers a creamy iris and light floral note which is very clean and powdery. The warm woodiness from sandalwood, cedar, and patchouli at the base is very intimate and close to skin. This fragrance is contemporary, tranquil, and extremely corporate, thus, it is well suited for daily use.

products.title: Prada Carbon Luna Rossa Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau De Toilette is a modern and refreshing fragrance for men that exudes cleanliness, coolness, and toughness simultaneously. It starts off with a brisk and sharp citrus of bergamot and pepper that is both refreshing and invigorating. Gradually, lavender and aquatic notes appear, imparting a mellow and light feeling. During the dry down period, ambroxan and patchouli contribute a subtle woody note that lingers on the skin for a long time. This fragrance feels manly, fashionable, and suitable for everyday use.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Layton Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The fragrance Parfums De Marly Layton Eau De Parfum is a fresh and rich perfume with a little touch of sweetness that gives a classy and smooth feeling. The fragrance begins with an appealing combination of apple, lavender, and citrus that is very much like clean and bright. The whole palette of notes is huge, and at first, it is floral, soft and elegant, but slowly it is giving its way to the vanilla and woody notes that are now warm and deep. The scent is luxurious, self-assured, and extremely delightful, and it would be just right for those men who love the combination of fresh and sweet perfumes.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Haltane Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums De Marly Haltane Eau De Parfum graciously accepts the entry of manly character. Its scent profile is rich, green, and woody. For sure, the first impression is the invigorating fusion of lavender, clary sage, and bergamot that radiate cleanliness and sophistication. Eventually, the warm saffron with the sweet praline take the lead, providing a soft and velvety feel. The base of oud and cedar is deep, and woody, and has the longest tenacity that is why this fragrance is beautifully bold, refined, and potent.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Herod Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums De Marly Herod is a warm, rich, and sophisticated fragrance for men that has a deep and silky character. The first impression is a combination of spicy cinnamon and pepperwood that comes off as daring and a bit sweet. Gradually, the whole thing becomes smoky with tobacco and incense, which is very powerful and masculine. The final stage is a blend of vanilla, woods, and musk that is very pleasant and lasts for a long time. This perfume is a statement of luxury and self-assurance and it's for men who are fond of strong and warm fragrances.

products.title: Ormonde Jayne Nawab Of Oudh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ormonde Jayne Nawab Of Oudh Eau de Parfum is a unisex oriental fragrance from Ormonde Jayne, created by Geza Schoen. Launched in 2012, it combines spicy, floral, and woody notes into a smooth, luxurious scent. Orange, bergamot, cardamom, aldehydes and green notes introduce the fragrance with fresh and zesty top notes. The middle notes of the scent are composed of the floral and warm notes of rose, pimento, cinnamon, orchid, magnolia, bay leaf and hedione. Finally, the base notes provide a rich and deep finish of agarwood (oud), ambergris, vetiver, musk and labdanum.

products.title: Neesh Luxe Hayat Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Luxe Hayat Extrait De Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this fragrance feels modern but also very classic at heart. The scent opens up with fresh citrus notes combined with soft neroli, which makes the start very clean and bright. The floral notes of rose, jasmine and orris together with patchouli are revealed as the scent develops, and they impart warmth and depth to the fragrance. The soft and slightly sweet base consists of white chocolate, vanilla, oud and sandalwood, which creates a feel of luxury that is also very lasting. It smells premium, comforting and confident.

products.title: Neesh Haute Tobacco Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Haute Tobacco Extrait De Parfum is a bold and rich scent made for men who like deep and strong perfumes. Initially, it reveals a fresh and fruit-like aroma of pear and apple combined with spicy pink pepper and bergamot. The warm tobacco slowly enters through the middle notes, accompanied by saffron, cardamom and soft floral notes. The base notes of amber, sandalwood, vanilla and musk create a smooth and weighty sensation on the skin, imparting a refined and long-lasting effect.

products.title: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Glazed Water Extrait De Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern aquatic scent made for men who like a cool and classy smell. It starts with bright marine and citrus notes that are like a gentle sea breeze on the skin, turning spicy and soft gradually and finally, warm woody notes dominate the dry down. Due to the extrait concentration, the perfume feels light, refreshing and yet strong.

products.title: Nautica Voyage Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage Eau De Toilette for men is a fresh, clean and easy-going fragrance from the house of Nautica. It is made for daily wear and feels light, cool and relaxing. The scent opens with crisp green leaves and juicy apple that feels very fresh on first spray. The heart of the fragrance introduces the very gentle floral notes of lotus and mimosa that provide a creamy and watery sensation. Finally, musk, cedar, oakmoss and amber round up the scent’s drying process, making it a very clean but to a great extent still gentle and pleasant woody base on the skin.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Eau De Parfum is a clean, deep and modern scent made for men who like simple but classy perfumes. It opens smooth and fresh, then slowly turns dark, woody and musky. This fragrance feels calm, confident and very elegant without being loud. It is perfect for daily wear as well as special evenings. The musky heart makes it feel warm and personal, almost like a skin scent but stronger.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Toilette is a soft, classy women’s perfume. It is known for its clean musky feel with light flowers and warm woods. This fragrance feels elegant but simple, not loud at all. It has a fresh and floral opening, gradually becoming creamy and warm on the skin. It is a perfume that feels very close, smooth and comforting, so that it is suitable for everyday use and special moments as well.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum is a soft, elegant and very feminine perfume. It reveals a combination of fresh rose and a delicate fruity touch of peach at the very beginning. The middle notes consist primarily of pure white musky scent, which is layered with the warmth of amber. The base consists of patchouli and sandalwood, which provide a smooth, woody finish.

products.title: Moschino Toy Boy Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Moschino Toy Boy Eau De Parfum is a bold and modern men’s perfume from the designer house of Moschino. It comes with a fresh spicy opening that slowly turns warm and woody. The scent feels playful, classy and a bit edgy at the same time. Pink pepper and pear make a sharp and fresh beginning, whereas rose and spices add richness to the middle. The end is smooth, woody and a little sweet, which nicely lingers on the skin.

products.title: Montale Roses Musk Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Roses Musk Eau De Parfum is one of the most simple yet beautiful rose perfumes from the house of Montale. It is a clean, bright and shiny kind of rose scent that mixes fresh rose petals, soft jasmine and a smooth white musk. The perfume smells elegant and a bit romantic, like fresh roses in a warm room. It is easy to wear every day and still feels classy.

products.title: Montale Intense Cafe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Intense Café Eau De Parfum is a warm, sweet and cozy unisex scent that merges smooth coffee, soft rose and creamy vanilla. It was launched in 2013 and has that calm café vibe with a touch of sweetness and a gentle musky base.

products.title: Montale Aoud Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Aoud Leather Eau De Parfum is a strong and bold unisex perfume that mixes rich oud with clean, warm leather. It is a deep and smooth scent that gives a powerful first impression and keeps the same strength for long hours. A mix of leather, oud, saffron, bergamot, cardamom, pepper and ambergris creates a smoky, spicy and warm smell that feels both classy and wild.

products.title: Montblanc Individuel Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Montblanc Individuel Eau De Toilette is a classy and clean men’s perfume with a soft, sweet and woody feel. The first impression of the fragrance is a striking combination of herbs and spices with a tiny bit of fruit, but the transition to warmth and smoothness is rather slow. Along the way, the aroma becomes very soft and sweet.

products.title: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montblanc Explorer Eau De Parfum is a modern men’s perfume made for guys who like a clean, fresh and a little bit woody kind of smell. It starts with a very refreshing note of the bergamot and a gentle spicy tone. The middle notes are quite heavy due to the combination of leather and Haitian vetiver. The base contains smooth notes of ambroxan, akigalawood, patchouli leaf and a very slight touch of cacao sweetness.

products.title: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum is a warm, bright and spicy unisex scent that mixes sweet florals with fresh citrus and deep musky notes. The scent opens strong with saffron, ginger, mandarin and bergamot, giving a bold and shiny start. In the middle, you get amberwood, Moroccan rose, Egyptian jasmine and patchouli leaf that add a soft but rich touch. The dry down of vanilla, white musk, sandalwood and oakmoss makes the perfume smooth, creamy and long-lasting.

products.title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum is a bright, fresh, and modern unisex fragrance that mixes juicy citrus with smooth woods and soft musk. Inspired by sunny days and easy elegance, this perfume opens with a splash of zesty Sicilian lemon, refreshing bergamot, and a hint of spicy black currant. As it settles, fruity notes blend with soft jasmine and earthy patchouli leaf, adding depth and charm. The dry-down is warm and creamy with cedar, leather, vanilla, and white musk that stay on your skin for hours.

Mancera Cedrat Boise is a perfect everyday fragrance for people who love fresh, energetic scents with a classy twist. It feels youthful yet sophisticated, making it a favourite for both men and women who want to smell fresh, clean, and stylish all day long.

products.title: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a bold and heavy unisex scent known for its rich, smoky and sweet spicy style. It starts loud with warm cinnamon, oud, incense, saffron, nutmeg and some fruity green apple and pear. Then it melts into a simple heart of patchouli and jasmine. The dry down comes strong with thick tobacco, sweet vanilla, amber, sandalwood, guaiac wood, white musk and vetiver.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica By The Fireplace Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica By The Fireplace Eau De Toilette is a warm and cozy unisex fragrance that gives the soft, smoky feeling of sitting close to a wooden fire on a cold winter night. It starts with a combination of spicy cloves and pink pepper, then moves to sweet chestnut and smooth woods in the middle and finally ends with a mellow, creamy base of vanilla, Peru balsam and cashmeran.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Jazz Club Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Jazz Club Eau De Toilette is a warm, smooth and cozy scent made to feel like a relaxed night in a dim jazz bar. The fragrance is opens with bright and spicy top notes of pink pepper, neroli and lemon that form the opening. It appears then, the middle notes of sweet rum, vetiver and clary sage are mixed. The fragrance then draws to an end with a mixture of tobacco leaf, vanilla bean and styrax, which is soft and warm on the skin.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau De Parfum is one of the most famous unisex perfumes in the world. It has this warm, sweet and airy aura that feels kind of glowing on the skin. The mixture of saffron, jasmine, amberwood, fir resin and cedar makes it smell rich, smooth and also a bit mysterious. It has a sweet woody smell with a little sparkle that stays on skin for long hours without feeling too heavy.

products.title: Le Labo Santal 33 Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Santal 33 Eau De Parfum is a warm, dry and smoky unisex scent that has become a modern classic since its launch. It blends creamy sandalwood, soft leather, papyrus, cardamom spice and clean woods like cedar to create a calm, earthy smell that feels simple but very addictive. The mix also has violet and iris, giving a smooth, soft touch in the heart, while amber adds a little warm glow in the base.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Eau De Parfum is a soft, sweet and creamy perfume for women who enjoy warm vanilla scents with a tropical twist. The top notes are the gentle combination of orchid, heliotrope and a bit of fresh tangerine. The middle notes deliver the sweetness of the gourmand and the juiciness of the tropical fruits mixed. Finally, the fragrance dries down to a warm and comforting base of vanilla, soft musk and sandalwood that keeps the smoothness on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Rose Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Rose Eau De Parfum is a soft, warm and romantic floral scent made for both men and women. It starts with a sweet and fresh rose along with a small amount of patchouli on top. The scent in the middle becomes smooth with musk and labdanum, which adds a delightful amber type feel to it. The dry down end of the fragrance is calm, warm and slightly creamy with musk and amber that lasts close to your skin for a long time.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Oud Eau De Parfum is a deep, warm and bold unisex scent from the house of Lattafa. It mixes smoky incense, rich leather, strong oud, warm amber and soft musk into a thick, dark cloud of sweet, smoky woods. The scent opens with a hint of citrus that feels bright for a few seconds but quickly melts into spicy cinnamon, heavy oud, and warm amber. It is known for its dark and powerful aura, making it a perfect pick for people who love strong Arabic-style perfumes.

products.title: Lattafa Ramz Silver Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ramz Silver Eau De Parfum is a smooth and modern unisex scent that opens fresh and sweet at the same time. It starts with juicy pear, soft lavender, cool mint and bright bergamot. The heart brings warm cardamom and clean sage. The dry-down is rich and cosy with vanilla, amber, musk and patchouli.

products.title: Lattafa Ramz Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ramz Gold Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and fruity scent that feels both bright and soft. It starts off with an explosion of fruits like a crunchy apple, juicy peach, tangy blackcurrant, sweet pear and zesty orange. The floral heart consists of rose, jasmine and orange blossom which not only imparts a fresh quality but also smooths the scent. The base is a mix of milk and warmth with sandalwood, white musk, vanilla and patchouli.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Eau De Parfum is a creamy, warm and bold unisex perfume from the house of Lattafa. It has a strong oriental style with sweet spices, deep woods, soft leather and smoky oud. The opening is spicy with cinnamon, cardamom, and bergamot. The heart has saffron, sandalwood, cedar and carnation, giving a warm and creamy feel. The dry down becomes sweet, woody and slightly smoky with oud, vanilla, leather and amber.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Reminiscence Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Reminiscence Eau De Parfum is a warm oriental scent with a bright fruity opening and a smooth woody base. It starts with fresh notes of bergamot, apple and pineapple that feel clean and juicy. Then rose, birch, patchouli and Moroccan jasmine delight you with a floral & smoky quality. Finally, musk, oakmoss, vanilla, and ambergris create a warm soft cloud that remains on the skin like a cozy and gentle hug.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Elixir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Elixir Eau De Parfum is a warm and deep scent for Men and Women that mixes spicy, sweet and woody notes in a very smooth way. It opens with saffron, nutmeg and a touch of cinnamon that feels rich and spicy. The center note becomes a combination of oud, suede and sandalwood, which is soft, smoky and creamy and thus gives the fragrance a quite pleasant character. The amber and vanilla mix forming the dry-down is not only sweet but warm as well, and this base stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum is a warm, rich and deep unisex perfume from the well-known house of Lattafa. It has a strong Middle Eastern touch with spicy, sweet and woody notes. The scent opens with a soft mix of rose, saffron and a little peppery pimento. In the middle, you get caramel, floral notes, patchouli and a beautiful oud tone that gives a dark and sweet feel. The dry down is warm with amber, resins, musk, incense and woody notes that stay long on skin and clothes.

products.title: Lattafa Najdia Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Najdia Eau De Parfum is a fresh and bright unisex scent that mixes citrus, light spices, soft woods and clean watery notes. It opens with a sharp hit of lemon, bergamot, cinnamon, apple and lemongrass that gives an instant fresh-spicy feeling. Then the heart brings refreshing watery notes, lavender, rosemary and cardamom that make the scent clean, cool and smooth. Finally, the base gets all warm and cozy with musk, amber, sandalwood, cedar and a slight touch of tobacco which adds a gentle depth to the perfume without making it too heavy.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that mixes floral, fruity and warm oriental notes. The opening consists of red berries, peach and bergamot that are very sweet and juicy so they create a fresh and playful start. The heart reveals soft blossom of jasmine, peony and red lily. Then, the base of sandalwood, vanilla flower and musk create a creamy and warm dry-down that is become smart and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and deep oriental scent made for both men and women. It starts with the spiciness of black pepper, pink pepper and saffron, which are all together giving a powerful and fresh beginning. The middle note combines smoky cade oil with labdanum, balsam and rhubarb for a dark, warm and rich feeling. Finally, the base of smooth leather, cedar, guaiac wood, patchouli, moss and musk creates a fragrant, lasting and classy perfume.

products.title: Lattafa Hayati Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Hayati Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and smooth unisex perfume made for people who love a classy yet modern scent. The opening part is bright and fruity due to the juicy scent of apple and bergamot. Then the heart warms us with the spiciness of cinnamon and woody notes, thus giving us depth and comfort. At last, the base composed of musk and vanilla delivers a smooth and creamy finish that is long-lasting, elegant and beautiful all day long.

products.title: Lattafa Fakhar Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Fakhar Men Eau De Parfum is a rich oriental scent made for confident men who love strong, fresh and woody notes. Launched in 2022, this perfume opens with bright and spicy touches of apple, bergamot and ginger. The heart consists of a soft and smooth mix of lavender, sage, juniper berries and geranium that is cool yet masculine. The tonka bean, amberwood and vetiver make a powerful, warm and woody base that lasts for hours.

products.title: Lattafa Fakhar Gold Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Fakhar Gold Extrait De Parfum is a rich and classy perfume for men from the famous house of Lattafa. It opens with a bright, spicy touch of grapefruit, pink pepper and cardamom. The middle mixes soft tuberose with warm solar notes and herbal artemisia. The dry down is deep and comforting, filled with amber, leather, labdanum and smooth cashmeran.

products.title: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum is a creamy, bold and classy scent for both men and women. It mixes fresh citrus and spicy notes with a warm woody base that makes it perfect for all-day wear. The perfume presents a citrus explosion of orange and cardamom, then the sweet patchouli comes along with the hot pepper. The base notes give a thick combination of amber, cedar, vetiver and oakmoss which makes it really charming and powerful.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Eau de Parfum is a bold and rich fragrance for men from the house of Lattafa. Launched in 2021, it is a perfect mix of spicy, woody, and sweet notes. The top notes of black pepper, tobacco, and pineapple give it a fresh yet spicy start. The heart combines patchouli, coffee, and iris for a warm and smooth feel. The base of vanilla, amber, dry wood, benzoin, and labdanum makes it linger on skin with a deep, oriental touch.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and luxurious unisex fragrance. Introduced in 2017, it literally combines all the notes of the fresh, spicy, and warm fragrance family making the whole composition leather-centric and smooth. The fruity and spicy mix of juniper berries, cardamom, pink pepper, and raspberry marks up the top notes. The middle has the floral and slightly hot scent of iris, ginger, and rose. The bottom or base note is composed of a combination of leather, white musk, and amber, which are rich and sensual thus leaving a long-lasting impression.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum is a clean, soft, and refreshing unisex scent that feels simple yet very elegant. It opens with bright citrusy notes of bergamot and orange, giving a fresh and uplifting start. In the middle of the fragrance are vanilla and pear, which produce a very smooth and creamy sweetness and are very pleasant to smell. At last, it is the warm musk and amber in the base that make it cozy, last a long time, and are suitable for daily use.

products.title: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum is a sweet and cheerful fragrance perfectly made for women. The opening notes reveal fresh blackcurrant and delightful pear that are light and fruity at the same time. The middle notes of iris, jasmine, and orange blossom give the fragrance a smooth and elegant touch with soft floral notes. The warm and comforting base composed of praline, vanilla, patchouli, and tonka bean also contributes to the fragrance being long-lasting and suitable for women who adore sweet, elegant, and happy scents.

products.title: Lalique Encre Noire Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Encre Noire Lalique EDP for men is a dark, woody, and mysterious fragrance that is perfect for evening and special occasions. It opens with a fresh and green cypress note, followed by a heart of smooth vetiver, and settles into a rich, warm base of cashmere wood and musk. Created by Nathalie Lorson in 2006, this fragrance is loved for its deep, masculine aroma and long-lasting scent.

products.title: Kilian Angels’ Share Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Kilian Angels’ Share is a very luxurious, sweet, and warming scent that possesses the character of a delicate dessert. The initial note is a very warm and boozy-smelling cognac, which is followed by a very soft and comforting mixture of cinnamon and tonka bean. The texture of the scent gets softer with the combination of vanilla, praline, and candied almond, which makes the fragrance pretty much creamy, soft, and very addictive.
