The whole aura of the fragrance is elegant and tasty, thus it suits well to sweet, strong, and warm scent lovers who do not mind their fragrance lasting for long hours.

products.title: Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper is a strong, spicy, and sweet fragrance that is bold but soft on the skin at the same time. It has a bright blend of pink pepper, saffron, and bergamot, with a spicy-sweet start, on top. After that, it goes to a magnificent rose and vanilla orchid heart, coming very floral, creamy, and a bit sweet. The bottom notes of amber, sandalwood, patchouli, and musk impart warmth, smoothness, and longevity to the fragrance. It is a perfume that exudes confidence, playfulness, and the ideal choice for a person who enjoys both sweet and spicy scents simultaneously.

products.title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir perfume is a women's fragrance that is sweet, bold, and playful with a rich and glamorous feeling. It starts with juicy wild berries along with a hint of mandarin orange and the impression is of freshness and fun. The heart of the fragrance consists of gardenia, jasmine, and honeysuckle which form the base of the creamy floral smell. The end notes of caramel, vanilla, amber, and sandalwood blend together to form a warm, sweet, and smooth base that lasts for many hours. The scent is perfect for women who love sweet, flirty, and feminine fragrances but with a little depth.

products.title: Jimmy Choo Jimmy Choo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Jimmy Choo Jimmy Choo Eau De Parfum is a sweet and fruity women’s perfume that feels playful, fresh, and modern. It opens with juicy pear, soft mandarin, and green notes that smell bright and clean. As it settles, the orchid note brings a light floral touch that feels smooth on the skin. The dry down of toffee and patchouli adds a warm, sweet, and slightly bold finish. This scent is great for women who like sweet-fresh perfumes that feel feminine and stylish for daily wear.

products.title: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau De Toilette is a modern and delightful men’s perfume that presents a very clean, fresh, and slightly sweet scent. At one end, the fragrance has a very strong, sharp, icy freshness, owing to citrus notes like citron, bergamot, and mandarin. In the centre of the fragrance development, the smell turns to be somewhat woody and fruity with the apple, cedar, and vetiver parts providing a very gentle mix. Musk, ambroxan, and moss, which is the foundation, keep it soft, modern, and very wearable. It is an uncomplicated yet cultured fragrance for regular applications.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau De Toilette is a fresh, warm, and slightly sweet men's fragrance that mixes marine notes with creamy vanilla. It opens with cool mint and soft watery notes that feel clean and refreshing. The middle brings a strong sea note, giving that salty ocean vibe. When it dries down, the vanilla and ambergris make the scent warm, inviting, and a bit sensual. It is a simple but charming everyday fragrance that many men enjoy for its freshness and comfort.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Intense Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Intense is a sweet, fresh, and bold men’s perfume that feels active and very strong. The first impression is of a rich pear fragrance completed by lavender, mint, bergamot and lemon, which together provide a fresh and a little bit sweet beginning. There are warm cinnamon and clary sage that together give a spicy and smooth feeling. The bottom notes include the very strong vanilla, amber, patchouli, and cedar, which leave a very long-lasting impression on skin. It conveys confidence, youthfulness, and is suitable for men who prefer sweet yet strong perfumes.

products.title: Jaguar Classic Black Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jaguar Classic Black Eau De Toilette is a smooth, fresh, and slightly warm men’s fragrance that combines fruits, spices, and deep woody notes. It opens with crisp apple and bright citrus that feel clean and sharp. In the middle, you get tea, sea breeze notes, and soft spices that give a cool and calming vibe. The base is warm with musk, cedarwood, sandalwood, and tonka bean, making it soft, sweet, and classy. It is a simple, everyday masculine scent that feels modern, clean, and comforting.

products.title: Jaguar Classic Gold Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jaguar Classic Gold Eau De Toilette is a warm, woody, and fresh men’s fragrance that feels smooth and classy. It opens with a juicy combination of apple, bergamot and lime that gives a sharp bright start. Soon, the scent turns softer with orange blossom and teak wood, giving it a sweet woody middle. In the dry down, vanilla, patchouli and musk add a warm creamy finish that feels very comforting. It is simple, elegant, and a perfect everyday scent that feels clean and confident.

products.title: Issey Miyake Nuit D'issey Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake Nuit D’Issey Eau De Toilette is a deep, mysterious, and bold men’s perfume that feels like the calm of night. It opens with fresh grapefruit and bergamot, giving a bright but sharp start. The middle slowly turns warm with leather, woods, spices, black pepper, and a hint of vetiver. The base settles into smoky incense, dark ebony wood, patchouli, and soft tonka bean. It smells confident, masculine, and powerful, perfect for men who like strong night fragrances.

products.title: Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake L’Eau D’Issey Pour Homme is a fresh, clean, and uplifting perfume for men with a gentle woody touch. It opens with bright citrus notes like yuzu, lemon, mandarin and bergamot that feel very crisp and refreshing. The middle brings a combination of spicy nutmeg, saffron, cinnamon and soft florals like blue lotus and lily-of-the-valley that give a smooth balance. As it dries down, it turns warm, woody and a bit musky with vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, amber and a soft tobacco note. It is a timeless, everyday fragrance that feels light, natural and very easy to wear.

products.title: Hermes Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Terre D’Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau De Parfum is a rich, earthy, and fresh men’s fragrance that brings a deeper twist to the classic Terre d’Hermes. It opens with sharp citrus from bergamot, grapefruit, and lemon that feels bright and clean. The middle adds a spicy kick of Sichuan pepper with a soft touch of geranium. The base is warm, deep, and very earthy with strong vetiver, olibanum, patchouli, and amberwood. This scent feels elegant, powerful, and grounded, perfect for men who like a natural and mature aroma.

products.title: Hermes Terre D'hermes Eau Givree Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Hermes Terre D’Hermes Eau Givree is a fresh, bright, and cool fragrance that combines citrus with soft woods. It opens with a sharp and icy citron note that feels clean and energising. The middle brings juniper berries and timur pepper, giving a spicy and aromatic touch. As it dries down, the scent turns smooth with mineral and woody notes, making it calm, earthy, and elegant. It feels modern, refreshing, and perfect for men who like a crisp, clean, and classy everyday perfume.

products.title: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum is one of those perfumes that are warm, daring, and classic all at once, and the oriental richness is definitely the main reason for its popularity among perfume lovers. It starts with citrus notes, illuminating bergamot and lemon, then goes into a deep floral-earthy heart consisting of iris, jasmine, rose, vetiver, and patchouli, finally ending in a soft base of vanilla, incense, leather, sandalwood, and musk. It is perceived as classic, smooth, slightly smoky, and elegant with a very effortless touch.

products.title: Guerlain Samsara Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Samsara Eau De Parfum is a calming women's perfume that sheds warmth and depth while its ingredients create a drama of the creamy florals and the creamy woods combined. First comes ylang-ylang, peach, bergamot, and lemon and then the smooth heart delivered by jasmine, iris, violet, and rose comes. The dry-down consists of sandalwood, vanilla, amber, tonka bean, and musk, which make a very creamy and sensual scent. It is considered to be a tranquil, sensual, and very enduring fragrance that evokes a classic feel.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau De Parfum is a captivating, luxurious, and warm men's scent with a mellow almond top note that is mixed with spices, lavender, bergamot, rosemary, and thyme. The middle consists of cherries, vanilla, incense, and soft rose. The base note is of very leather, tonka bean, and sandalwood. This perfume is known for its sweetness-woodiness balance that has a lasting and elegant feel on the skin. It has earned a special place among the fragrance community for its powerful projection, velvety blending of different notes, and sophisticated gentlemanly vibe.

products.title: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau De Parfum for men is a lavish and classy scent with an excellent combination of warm and woody tones. The fragrance starts off with fresh and lively bergamot, which is combined with the soft feel of rum and vanilla in the middle, then ends with a strong base of patchouli. This perfume was made by Delphine Jelk in 2024 and is very much appreciated for its elegant smell and stamina, hence, it is perfect for nighttime or special events.

products.title: Gucci Guilty Man Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Parfum is a warm, woody, and fresh masculine perfume that feels bold but also soft in the drydown. It opens with clean and bright top notes of juniper, lavender, and lemon. The heart brings a smooth combination of orange blossom, nutmeg, and Spanish labdanum that adds warmth and depth. The base settles into dry wood, patchouli, and musk, giving a strong and charming finish. The blend feels modern, classy, and perfect for men who like deep and comforting scents.

products.title: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum is a floral perfume with a fresh, soft scent, and it is made for women who appreciate simple, pure and elegant perfumes. At the beginning, the sweet scent of jasmine is predominant, then creamy and rich tuberose prevails, and finally, the unusual floral note of rangoon creeper is perceived. This perfume was created in 2017 by Alberto Morillas, and it feels natural, feminine and smooth on the skin. The scent is intimate, leaving a delicate and long-lasting floral aura that many women like to wear during the day and at night.

products.title: Givenchy Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum for women is a warm, elegant, and sensual fragrance that is classic and feminine. The first notes are spicy nutmeg, fresh bergamot, sweet gardenia, and soft flowers, then it is rich heart comprising tuberose, jasmine, iris, honeysuckle, and peony. The drydown is a mix of vanilla, amber, cedarwood, guaiac wood, and soft woods making it creamy and deep. The fragrance is described as a timeless scent with a smooth sweet and floral blend, which is ideal for women who prefer a bold but elegant perfume.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau de Parfum is an appealing, sophisticated, and intense fragrance that is suitable for men during the evening. The top note is a soft and smooth burst of bergamot which is quickly replaced by the combination of creamy and powdery iris note alongside roasted chestnut in the heart. The base note consists of the likes of whiskey, wood, and amber which makes the overall feel sweet, boozy, and warm. The scent gives out luxury, elegance, and romance. Besides, it is an ideal fragrance for the cold nights, dinners, dates, and other romantic occasions.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum for Men is a delightful fragrance that masterfully communicates the spicy and sweet notes in its own classy way. The first impression consists of black pepper, lavender, and bergamot, which provide the freshness, after which the heart notes of orris, cloves, and cinnamon give the warmth. The base consists of the very deep and sophisticated notes of black vanilla husk, tolu balsam, tonka bean, benzoin, and patchouli.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Profondo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum for men is a fresh and deep ocean-inspired scent that starts with cool marine notes and bright green mandarin, moves to a soft mimosa heart, and ends with earthy patchouli and warm labdanum base. Created in 2024, it's part of the famous Acqua di Giò line, loved for its clean, lasting vibe that feels like a dive into clear blue waters. Many in the fragrance world call it a top pick for its smooth mix of notes, good throw, and easy wear that stands out without being too much.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Pour Homme Eau De Parfum for men is a fresh powerful scent perfect for warm days, it starts with cool sea notes and zesty green mandarin, then moves to herbal clary sage lavender and geranium in the heart, finishes with smooth mineral vetiver and patchouli base. Made by Alberto Morillas in 2022. Folks in fragrance circles love it as a modern upgrade to the classic, super clean aquatic vibe with solid staying power and nice reach that feels just right.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Si Fiori Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Si Fiori EDP feels like your favourite light dress on a perfect spring day – simple, pretty, and makes you smile the second you put it on. Right when you spray, black currant and green mandarin hit you with this juicy, happy pop, like fruit straight from the market. Then it softens into neroli and rose that smell fresh-picked, with just a whisper of patchouli and oakmoss to keep it real. Vanilla and white musk hug you at the end, warm but never heavy. Julie Massé cooked this up in 2019 to say, “hey, be you, even when the city’s loud”. Perfume fans rave about how easy it is to wear all day, sweet enough to lift your mood, light enough to never bug anyone.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Absolu Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Absolu Eau De Parfum is a refined fragrance that infuses woody and fresh notes. This is a perfect example of balance between warmth of woods and energy of the sea. Perfumer Alberto Morillas created this scent in 2018. He is a master perfumer who has been working with Acqua di Gio since 1996. This marine-woody scent also infuses fruity notes, presenting a unique masculine mixture of marine aromas with patchouli. It celebrates a vital, natural sensuality. The best part is that it combines the fragrances of the Sea Notes, Bergamot, pear, Apple, Grapefruit, Lemon, Lavender, Rosemary, Geranium, Woody notes, Tinka Bean, Amberwood, Patchaiu and Labdanum.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Code Parfum for men is a bold, sensual evening scent that mixes fresh bergamot and green bergamot leaf at the start, flows into a powdery heart of iris, aldehydes, clary sage, and orris, then settles into a warm base of tonka bean and cedar. Created by Antoine Maisondieu in 2022, it keeps the classic Code DNA but adds more depth and sensitivity. People in the fragrance world call it the modern king of night scents, strong yet soft, with an amazing blend of notes, top-notch quality, and projection that fills the room just right, sillage that lingers nicely without being too much.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum
products.body_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum stands as a modern, profound interpretation of the legendary Acqua Di Gio collection. It masterfully achieves balance by merging the invigorating freshness of marine notes with the inherent richness of woody undertones, resulting in a fragrance that projects both purity and significant power. 

The opening sequence delivers the bright, airy freshness of marine notes and bergamot, creating an initial impression reminiscent of a clean sea breeze and crisp citrus. This evolves into an aromatic core of rosemary, clary sage, and geranium, which introduces a distinct herbal depth. Finally, the scent anchors itself with warm notes of olibanum and patchouli, providing a grounded, lasting, and deeply masculine trail. Crafted by master perfumer Alberto Morillas, this fragrance is built on a foundation of clean, confident, and enduring sophistication, making it an ideal choice for the man who values an effortlessly elegant and timeless scent.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Code Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Code EDT for men is a fresh seductive scent with bright green mandarin top, clean lavender heart, warm tonka bean cedar base. It came out in 2023, made refillable with sustainable ingredients. People in the fragrance world love it as the modern take on seduction, clean yet warm, great for guys who want to smell put together, nice trail and lasting power.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum is a warm, deep, and cozy smell. It feels rich right from the start. It mixes the smooth sweet of caramel and raspberry with a little fresh orange. This makes a creamy, nice opening. As it sits, the perfume infuses more. You get a flowery smell of rose, violet, and jasmine. This is mixed with patchouli and a bit of incense. It gives a soft, smoky, and mysterious feel. It is creamy, cozy, and a little spicy. It rests nicely on wood, musk, and spice smells. 

Franck Olivier Oud Vanille is the kind of scent that makes you feel wrapped up in luxury. It is not too loud. But people will notice you when you walk past. It is perfect for evenings or cold days. It leaves a sweet, deep smell that stays softly. This perfume is good for both men and women. It balances sweet, spice, and sexy smells well. It is not too strong.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum is very deep and rich. It feels warm, kinda Middle Eastern. It is fancy and bold. They made Oud Touch in 2014. It starts sweet. You smell caramel, raspberry, and orange. This is a smooth, little fruity start. Next, you smell flowers and earth. That is rose, jasmine, and patchouli. This mixes well with the last smells. Those are amber, vanilla, and musk. Franck Olivier Oud Touch is for guys who want a smell that is strong and stays a long time. Oud Touch is nice but easy to wear. It is best for nighttime or big events. The sweet and warm wood smell is perfect. It makes people remember you.

products.title: Franck Olivier Blue Touch Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Blue Touch Eau De Toilette is a fresh scent. It feels like you’re standing right by the ocean. But there's a nice woody accent mixed in too. It came out in 2011. It has a bright, zesty opening. You get a big rush of lemon, bergamot, green leaves, tangerine, and a small hint of pink pepper. It feels like a sunny morning. The middle section is cool and deep. This gives it a manly feel. That comes from melon, patchouli, vetiver, wood smells, sage, and galbanum. In the end, it gets warm. You get a lingering fresh scent from musk, oakmoss, and amber. This fragrance is for men who like clean, fresh, and maybe slightly spicy smells.

products.title: Franck Olivier Black Touch Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Black Touch Eau De Toilette is a classy, deep masculine scent that blends the comforting nature of wood with a bright touch of spice. The fragrance tends to smooth out and brings a balance as you reach the heart of this scent. The base represents the real depth of the fragrance and is what makes Black Touch last on the skin. It settles beautifully into warm, rich notes of vetiver, Virginia cedar, patchouli, musk, and vanilla, and these notes again bring warmth that welcomes you. Black Touch is for the man who wants to show a strong direct confidence. It has a great balance of both classic and modern sensibility, and is a great evening scent, special occasion scent, or any time you want to send out a strong statement that lasts.

products.title: Franck Boclet Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a robust, warm fragrance that feels incredibly cozy and almost addictive. It opens with a smooth blend of tobacco, juicy plum, and spicy ginger, leading to a smoky yet fruity beginning. As the fragrance evolves, you find a rich heart of cloves, creamy tonka bean, and dry cedarwood that adds a depth of richness and texture. The base wraps itself in warm vanilla, benzoin, and earthy vetiver and leaves a soft sweetness with just a gentle smokiness after the dry down.

products.title: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Erotic Eau De Parfum for Men & Women is a strong perfume. It is an incredible blend of warm spice and smooth wood notes. The scent kicks off with a fresh burst of rosemary, lemon, bergamot, and basil. This gives it a clean, slightly spicy opening. The middle layer has a lot going on: benzoin, heliotrope, cardamom, patchouli, tuberose, lavender, and oakmoss. This adds a lot of depth, plus creamy sweetness and rich herbs. The bottom notes are heavy. You get vanilla, amber, incense, sandalwood, and leather. Musk and cedar soften the whole thing up. This makes the entire scent finish deep and totally luxurious.

products.title: Franck Boclet Cocaine Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Cocaine Eau De Parfum is an enticingly intense, blistering scent. It has that rich, sweet, luxurious feeling. It opens up with caramel, red berries, bitter orange, and tobacco; and feels creamy, smokey, and somehow fruity. The heart has tuberose, orchid, and lily, which creates a soft, weighty floral accord. In the base, monoi oil, vanilla, and patchouli develop warm, deep qualities. It has a definite presence, is fun yet very classy. There is sweet quality here, but also an earthy balance. It is a great fragrance for anyone into heavier, richer fragrances that last.

products.title: Estee Lauder Pleasure For Men Eau De Cologne
products.body_html: Estee Lauder Pleasures For Men is a fresh, bright, and simple smell that has been a long-time favorite since the late 90s. The scent of this Eau De Parfum starts with grapefruit and watery notes, mixed with a smooth, soft sweetness from nectarine. The middle tone is warmer and spicy with ginger, peppery pimento, and clean lavender, which gives the cologne its manly feel. All of this settles onto a nice, solid base of deep sandalwood, warm ebony wood, and oakmoss. This whole scent feels like a relaxed, sunny afternoon.

products.title: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Forever Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Forever Eau De Parfum is described as joy in a bottle. It’s bright, juicy, and full of life fragrance makes it stand out. The fragrance has a cheerful splash of raspberry and zesty lemon peel, launching right into a sweet, vibrant start - that is sure to lift your spirits immediately. As the scent dried down, the heart tones present a blend of sweet almond, black currant, rose, and orange blossom. This feminine fragrance is perfect for any elegant, playful, pleasant look. The base notes are rooted in warm and cozy vibes with the scent of vanilla, patchouli, and musk. This fragrance feels like a warm hug. If you are a woman looking forward to a fresh and sweet scent, then this is for you.

products.title: Dunhill Indian Sandalwood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Indian Sandalwood Eau de Parfum is a classic woody fragrance for men. Launched in 2019, it opens with fresh and slightly sweet notes of carrot and bergamot (top notes); moves to a soft and earthy heart of orris and moss (middle notes); and rests on a warm, comforting base of Indian sandalwood, patchouli and cypriol oil (nagarmotha). It is a smooth, elegant scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Elite Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Elite Eau De Parfum is a classy and confident men’s scent that speaks style and strength. It was launched in 2016 by Alfred Dunhill, a brand known for luxury and refinement. The fragrance opens with fresh and bright top notes of cardamom, bitter orange, bergamot and lime. In the middle, the warm heart reveals vetiver, black pepper, blue sage and juniper which give a spicy and clean charm. The dry down is smooth with base notes of ebony, sandalwood, suede and labdanum giving it a deep and masculine finish.

products.title: Guy Laroche Drakkar Noir Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Drakkar Noir is a classic men’s fragrance with a bold, fresh, and clean scent. It opens with sharp citrus and herbs like lemon, lavender, and rosemary that feel very energising. Then it moves into spicy and green notes such as juniper, coriander, and jasmine that add depth. The base is warm, earthy, and masculine with oakmoss, leather, vetiver, fir, and patchouli. It is a timeless scent that many men use for daily wear, evenings, and even gym days because it smells confident and strong.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana The One Pour Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana The One Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a classic and men’s scent that mixes warm, spicy and woody notes into one elegant blend. It opens with fresh grapefruit, coriander and basil that feel clean and confident. The heart brings spicy touches of cardamom, ginger and a hint of orange blossom. The dry down is smooth and deep with amber, tobacco and cedar giving it a warm, masculine finish. It’s a perfect perfume for men who love a classy, charming scent that lasts through the day.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette is a classic men’s perfume known for its cool, fresh and confident vibe. Launched in 1988, it’s still a favorite for those who love clean and ocean-like scents. It starts with a mix of mint, green notes, lavender and rosemary, giving a crisp freshness, then brings soft hints of sandalwood, jasmine, and geranium. Finally, the base adds depth with musk, cedar, ambergris and tobacco, making it long lasting, masculine and refreshing all day.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a fresh and clean fragrance for men. It makes one experience of a cool ocean breeze on a hot, sunny day. It was launched in 2017. The Eau De Parfum begins with a sweet burst of grapefruit scent along with mandarin orange. The heart tones are surrounded by the warm musk  and amberwood smell. The soft and confident smell makes you effortlessly attractive on any day.

products.title: Creed Aventus Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum was launched in 2010 and was composed by French perfumers Jean-Christophe Hérault and Erwin Creed. It has been formulated multiple times since its release in order to achieve its current balanced and seamless concentration.  
Creed Aventus EDP for men has been chosen as the winner for the prestigious Best Fragrance of the Year—Basenotes Readers’ Awards (2011–2014) and Top 10 Fragrances of All Time—based on the user votes.

products.title: Creed Viking Cologne Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Viking Cologne EDP for men is a bold and invigorating fragrance inspired by strength and adventure. It opens with fresh and zesty top notes of mandarin orange, lemon, pink pepper, and bergamot. The heart blends aromatic lavender, geranium, rosemary, sage, and nutmeg, creating a dynamic and spicy character. The base settles into warm and earthy notes of vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, olibanum, and patchouli, giving it depth and lasting power. Viking Cologne is admired in the fragrance community for its balanced blend of citrus, spices, and woods, offering good projection and longevity.

products.title: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Oud Malaki Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that combines smoky woods, leather, and spices with a warm and deep oud base. This scent shows true luxury and elegance, made for men who love strong and royal perfumes. It starts fresh with grapefruit and lavender, turns deep with tobacco and leather, and finally settles into a base of oud, ambergris, and dark woods that gives a classy and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Chopard Jasmin Moghol Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Chopard Jasmin Moghol EDP is a luxurious fragrance for men and women. It opens with the soft, fresh scent of Chinese Jasmine that feels pure and uplifting. The middle notes combine Bulgarian Rose and Turkish Rose to give a romantic, flowery touch. Sandalwood in the base adds warmth and depth, making it perfect for evening wear. 

This perfume was created by Alberto Morillas in 2018, it is loved by fragrance lovers for its smooth floral aroma and balanced, long-lasting scent.

products.title: Chopard Amber Malaki Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Amber Malaki Eau De Parfum is an oriental unisex scent that feels warm, deep, and elegant. Launched in 2015, it is part of Chopard’s luxurious Malaki collection, inspired by the beauty of Middle Eastern perfumery. It opens with soft orange blossom and papyrus, leading to incense and labdanum at the heart, and finishes beautifully with warm amber and sweet vanilla at the base. This perfume gives a golden glow and feels like a cosy, classy evening wrapped in scent.

products.title: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau De Parfum is a delicate floral perfume made for women. It opens with fresh and sparkling notes of lily and citrus, which gives a soft and elegant feel. The heart is pure lily, keeping the floral theme alive, while the base is green lily and fresh green notes that make the perfume natural, light, and refreshing. It is perfect for women who like soft, floral, and graceful scents that feel fresh all day.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum is a glamorous fragrance for women that mixes bold dark notes with bright and sweet floral tones. Launched in 2016, this perfume became iconic not only for its scent but also for its stylish stiletto-shaped bottle. The fragrance opens with almond, coffee, bergamot, and lemon for a rich and addictive start. The heart blooms with tuberose, jasmine sambac, orange blossom, Bulgarian rose, and orris. The base is deep and warm with tonka bean, cacao, vanilla, praline, sandalwood, musk, amber, cashmere wood, patchouli, cinnamon, and cedar. Together, it creates a scent that feels powerful yet feminine, daring yet elegant.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau De Parfum is a bold oriental-woody fragrance made for men who love strong, deep, and daring scents. Launched in 2022, this perfume mixes fiery spices, rich cacao, earthy patchouli, and smoky incense into a daring yet classy blend. The fragrance opens with sharp freshness from bergamot and ginger, quickly moving into warm plum, clary sage, and exotic davana at the heart. The dry down is rich and intense with tonka bean, cacao, labdanum, patchouli, incense, and vetiver, leaving a lasting powerful trail.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum is a soft and romantic version of the iconic Good Girl line. Released in 2023, this fragrance brings a playful and feminine twist to the collection. It opens with the freshness of bergamot and almond, moving into a floral heart of peony and ylang-ylang. The base finishes with creamy vanilla and sweet coumarin, making the scent both warm and delicate. This perfume captures elegance, charm, and modern femininity in a light pink stiletto bottle that is as attractive as the fragrance inside.

products.title: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau De Parfum For Women
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau De Parfum for women is a modern, rich and seductive fragrance that was launched in 2021. It is a darker and more intense version of the original Euphoria. The perfume combines fruity freshness with sensual floral and woody notes, creating a bold statement for confident women. The composition opens with juicy black currant (top note), moves into exotic orchid (middle note), and dries down with deep earthy patchouli (base note).

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette is one of the most famous unisex perfume in the world which was launched in 1994 it brings a fresh and clean vibe that feels natural on both men and women. The Fragrance starts with citrus fruits like lemon, bergamot and mandarin orange, mixed with pineapple, green notes, cardamom and papaya and the middle brings a soft floral touch with jasmine, violet, rose, freesia, lily of the valley, nutmeg and orris root. The base is warm and balanced with green tea, sandalwood, musk, cedar, oakmoss, amber and green accords. CK One is simple, cool and made for everyday wear.

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Shock Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Calvin klein Ck One Shock Eau De Toilette is a masculine fragrance which was launched in 2011 this scent opens with a sharp burst of lavender, juicy clementine and refreshing cucumber the middle reveals a spicy combination of cardamom, pepper, basil and osmanthus creating an energetic kick. Finally this fragrance dries down into an addictive base of tobacco, amber, patchouli, woodsy notes and musk
This composition offers a modern twist with its oriental spicy accords making it an ideal choice for men who enjoy a confident and powerful scent.

products.title: Byredo Bal D'afrique Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a warm and elegant unisex fragrance inspired by African culture and Parisian spirit. Launched in 2009, this scent beautifully combines citrus, floral, and woody notes in a smooth balance. It opens with fresh Amalfi lemon, marigold, bergamot, black currant, and African orange flower. The middle notes of violet, cyclamen, and jasmine give it a soft floral charm, while the base of vetiver, musk, amber, and Virginia cedar adds depth and long-lasting warmth.

products.title: Bvlgari Wood Essence Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum is a bold, refreshing, and modern fragrance crafted for the urban man who never loses his connection to nature. It beautifully blends strong woody notes with fresh citrus and earthy green tones, making it perfect for men who are grounded yet ambitious.

Inspired by the harmony between nature and city life, Bvlgari Man Wood Essence gives off the feeling of a calm forest breeze in the middle of a city. It’s rich, smooth, and vibrant, a perfect choice for men who want their fragrance to be fresh but also deep and masculine.

products.title: Bvlgari Man In Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Man In Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance from the house of Bvlgari. Released in 2014, it carries a rich oriental floral DNA that is strong yet smooth. The perfume opens with spicy warmth blended with sweet rum and smoky tobacco. In the heart, the scent moves into leathery tones mixed with iris and tuberose. The dry down is deep with creamy tonka bean, smoky guaiac wood, and resinous benzoin, making it dark, masculine, and lasting.

products.title: Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette is a fresh, masculine fragrance inspired by the deep blue sea and the energy of ocean waves. It’s a scent that feels clean, refreshing, and full of life, perfect for men who want to smell crisp and confident all day.

The fragrance opens with a burst of juicy mandarin and orange, blended with the green freshness of petitgrain. At the heart, unique marine notes of seaweed meet soft lavender and cotton flower, giving it a cool yet sophisticated vibe. The base brings warmth and depth with Virginia cedar, patchouli, clary sage, and amber, making it long-lasting and memorable.

Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme is like stepping out of the ocean on a sunny day, fresh, cool, and effortlessly stylish. It’s perfect for men who want a clean signature scent for daily wear.

products.title: Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum is an intense, sensual, and elegant fragrance that captures the essence of a rainy evening in London. Inspired by the iconic Burberry trench coat and the beauty of blooming flowers after the rain, this perfume blends floral richness with warm, deep notes for a luxurious experience.

The fragrance opens with a burst of jasmine, creating a bright yet smooth introduction. The heart reveals the sweetness of peach and the romantic elegance of rose, while the base wraps you in warm amber and earthy patchouli.

Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum feels like slipping into a classic trench coat on a rainy night, walking through a garden filled with blossoms, and enjoying the comforting embrace of warm, golden lights. It is perfect for women who want to feel confident, feminine, and unforgettable.

products.title: Burberry London Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry London Eau de Parfum is a classic floral scent that exudes elegance and timeless appeal. Launched in 2006, this fragrance opens with sweet honeysuckle, fresh tangerine, and soft rose (top notes), followed by jasmine, tiare flower, peony, and clementine (middle notes) and finishes with warm musk, sandalwood, and patchouli (base notes). A perfect combination of freshness, florals, and warmth makes it one of the most loved Burberry perfumes for women.

products.title: Burberry Brit For Her Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry Brit For Her Eau De Parfum is a sweet, fresh, and playful fragrance that feels like a cosy hug on a winter morning. It blends juicy fruits, soft flowers, and warm, creamy notes to create a scent that is charming yet comforting.

The fragrance opens with a burst of fresh lime, sweet pear, and a hint of almond. Soon, the heart reveals a beautiful mix of candied almond, sugar, and soft peony flowers, making it both sweet and romantic. As it dries down, warm vanilla, tonka bean, amber, and mahogany wood wrap you in a smooth, cosy finish.

Burberry Brit For Her is perfect for women who love a feminine scent that is both casual and classy. It’s the kind of perfume that makes you feel confident and beautiful without being too loud.

products.title: Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum is a bold, classy, and warm fragrance that speaks of timeless elegance. Inspired by the royal city of Jaipur, this perfume blends zesty citrus, rich spices, and smooth vanilla for a scent that feels both powerful and comforting.

From the very first spray, fresh lemon and lemon verbena awaken your senses with a burst of energy. Soon, the heart reveals warm cinnamon and nutmeg, wrapping you in a spicy embrace. As it settles, creamy vanilla and woody notes create a deep, smooth finish that stays with you for hours.

Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum is perfect for men who love confident, long-lasting fragrances that leave a mark wherever they go. Whether you are at a wedding, a formal dinner, or an evening out, this scent makes sure you’re remembered.

products.title: Bentley Intense For Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bentley Intense For Men Eau de Parfum is a luxurious fragrance made for confident men which was Launched in 2013, it opens with spicy and fresh top notes of black pepper, bay leaf, and bergamot. The middle notes bring a combination of rum, woody notes, cinnamon, clary sage, and African geranium. Finally, the base settles into deep and warm notes of incense, leather, benzoin, cedar, and patchouli, creating a long-lasting masculine scent.

products.title: Bentley Black Edition Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bentley For Men Black Edition Eau de Parfum is a bold and classy men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Bentley. Launched in 2018, this scent is built on an oriental spicy DNA. It opens with a fresh and slightly sweet touch of violet, tangerine, pink pepper, and nutmeg. The heart is deeper with papyrus, earthy notes, jasmine, patchouli, and a smooth sweetness. The base is warm and masculine, with atlas cedar, moss, incense, tobacco, and tonka bean creating a rich finish that stays long and feels powerful yet elegant.

products.title: Bdk Gris Charnel Extrait
products.body_html: BDK Gris Charnel Extrait Eau de Parfum is a bold and sensual fragrance from the French niche house BDK Parfums. Launched in 2022, this extrait version is a darker and richer twist on the original Gris Charnel. It blends spicy cardamom, sweet fig, and smoky black tea (top notes); powdery iris, earthy vetiver, and warm cistus (heart notes); and a deep base of sandalwood, patchouli, vanilla, tonka bean, and cedar. The result is a sophisticated unisex scent that feels both modern and timeless.

products.title: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is a bold, deep, and mysterious fragrance designed for the modern man who lives confidently and makes a strong impression. Launched in 2018, Azzaro Wanted By Night EDP brings a unique blend of spicy cinnamon, fresh citrus, and rich woody notes, making it a perfect scent for evenings, special events, and cooler days.

Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is intense and sensual, made for those who own the night. With its warm, spicy character and deep masculine vibe, Azzaro Wanted By Night is often described as charismatic and seductive, ideal for parties, dates, and night outs.

products.title: Azzaro Most Wanted Eau De Parfum Intense
products.body_html:
Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau De Parfum Intense is a daring new fragrance for men launched in 2024. This EDP Intense edition builds on the success of the Most Wanted line with a fresher, deeper, and more sensual twist. The blend is bold yet refined, starting with a vibrant bergamot note, flowing into smooth lavender, and finishing with a mysterious moss and liquor accord.

Crafted for confident, modern men, Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense delivers a crisp aromatic edge balanced with dark sensuality. The result? A signature scent that feels energizing, powerful, and long-lasting.

products.title: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau De Toilette is a fresh fragrance for men. Launched in 2007, it mixes fruity, aromatic, and woody notes into a smooth and lively scent. The perfume opens with crisp green apple and bitter orange, giving a fresh and bright start. Its heart is warm with tea and subtle spices, while the base brings a masculine touch of musk, tonka bean, vetiver, cedar, oakmoss, and amber. Chrome Legend is a perfect mix of freshness and depth for everyday wear.

products.title: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum
products.body_html: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum is a bold and irresistible fragrance for men who love to make a lasting impression. Launched in 2022, this woody spicy scent blends warm bourbon vanilla with fresh ginger and rich woodsy notes. It’s a strong yet smooth perfume, perfect for men who are confident, daring, and never afraid to stand out. The sleek black bottle with a gun-chamber design reflects power and elegance, just like the scent inside.

products.title: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum is a luxurious unisex perfume from Armani Prive. Launched in 2010, it is a creamy oriental floral fragrance that combines classic Middle Eastern ingredients with a modern elegance. The scent opens with fresh rose and floral notes, moves to middle notes of agarwood and patchouli, and finishes with warm vanilla for a sensual, lasting impression. It’s perfect for people who love strong, elegant, and sophisticated perfumes.

products.title: Armani Prive Oud Royal Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armani Prive Oud Royal Intense Eau De Parfum is a luxurious unisex perfume from the house of Armani Prive. Launched in 2010, it is a deep and fragrance built around classic oriental woody accords. The perfume opens with saffron and rose giving a warm, spicy start; the heart is a smoky mix of agarwood (oud) and incense; the base settles into creamy sandalwood and amber for a long-lasting, elegant finish. It is perfect for anyone who loves a bold, sophisticated, and timeless scent.

products.title: Giorgio Armani In Love With You Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Giorgio Armani In Love With You EDP for women is a sweet, romantic scent that perfectly captures the feeling of falling head over heels. The fragrance opens with juicy, bright notes of raspberry, black currant, and sour cherry. It then blooms into a heart of rose, jasmine, and wormwood. It finally settles into a warm, grounded patchouli base. Launched in 2019, this perfume captures the rush of love, mixing gentle fruits and strong flowers, creating a vibe that is both fragile yet passionately strong. 


Fragrance lovers often call it an addictive, girly treat, describing it as the perfect date night magic with good staying power. It leaves a soft, sweet trail that people notice, often resulting in compliments all evening. Wearing it makes you feel pretty and confident, like you are wrapped in a cozy, lingering berry hug that is noticeable without being overwhelming.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Eau De Toilette For Men
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Eau De Toilette For Men is that sweet, spicy hug in a bottle you spray when you wanna feel warm and loved. It starts with a nutty chestnut and sugary pop that smells like dessert, then rolls into sage and lavender for a clean herbal twist. Vanilla and a smoky edge finish it off cozy and smooth. Cecile Matton whipped this up in 2017 as the guy side of a love duo, all about real, modern romance. It mixes sweet treats with fresh herbs, easy for everyday but special enough to get noticed, with a trail that sticks around just right.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum is a unisex fragrance launched in 2020. It is a bright and fresh perfume that opens with citrus and fruity notes of bergamot, lemon, black currant, lime, violet leaf, and ginger. The middle notes are soft florals like rose, iris, and jasmine and the final notes settle into a classy combination of ambroxan, musk, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a fragrance that feels clean, modern, and versatile, perfect for everyday wear or special evenings.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Pure Parfum
products.body_html:
Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Pure Parfum is a bold and powerful fragrance for men, launched in 2021. It has become one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world for its rich, smoky, and masculine aroma. Inspired by the luxury scent of Creed Aventus, this perfume opens with a sharp, citrusy blast and slowly transforms into a deep, woody experience. It’s perfect for men who prefer their perfume to be strong, long-lasting, and full of personality.


This version of the Pure Parfum is the most refined and intense in the Club De Nuit Intense range, offering a smooth yet powerful aroma that’s perfect for both daily use and special occasions.

products.title: Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau De Parfum is a delightfully playful and flirty fragrance that is as charming as its name. This scent is a candy-lover's dream, bottling the feeling of pure joy and irresistible sweetness. It’s designed for the woman who is fun-loving, confident, and loves to express her sweet side.

Sweet Like Candy smells like a delicious treat you can wear. It has a youthful, happy, and vibrant charm that is perfect for everyday wear. A single spray of Ariana Grande's Sweet Like Candy will wrap you in a cloud of sugary bliss, making you feel cheerful and irresistible.

products.title: Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum is a fresh, confident, and magnetic fragrance for the modern man who loves adventure. This perfume is an amazing blend of fresh citrus, rich woods, and warm musk that creates a memorable scent experience. It smells like success and confidence in a bottle.

L'aventure is incredibly versatile and loved for its ability to draw compliments. It’s perfect for the man who wants a signature scent that is both energetic and elegant. One spray of Al Haramain L'aventure makes you feel ready to conquer the day, whether you're in a business meeting or on a weekend trip.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Dahab Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Wisal Dahab Eau De Parfum is like liquid gold in a bottle. An elegant and sophisticated unisex fragrance, it perfectly balances fresh fruits, beautiful flowers, and warm woods. The name "Dhahab" means "gold" in Arabic, and this scent truly lives up to its name, offering a rich and luxurious experience.

Wisal Dahab smells classy, modern, and incredibly charming. It's designed for those who appreciate a fragrance that is both noticeable and graceful. A spray of Ajmal Wisal Dahab makes you feel confident and ready for any occasion, wrapping you in a beautiful golden aura of fruit and flowers.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum is a soft, elegant, and modern floral fragrance made for today’s confident women. Launched in 2010, Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum brings together the timeless beauty of fresh roses, warm spices, creamy sandalwood, and smooth musk. The result is a gentle yet long-lasting perfume that makes you feel fresh, graceful, and feminine all day long.

This beautiful fragrance is perfect for daily wear or for special occasions when you want to feel extra special and noticed. One spray of Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum is enough to leave behind a delicate floral trail that feels comforting and classy at the same time.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and energetic unisex fragrance that feels like a cool mountain breeze in a bottle. This scent is designed for the stylish individual who loves a clean and uplifting aroma. It beautifully balances zesty citrus fruits with soft florals and a clean, musky base, creating a perfectly refreshing and sophisticated experience.

Silver Shade smells yet smooth, with a touch of class that makes it incredibly versatile. It’s the perfect choice for anyone who wants a signature scent that is easy to wear daily but still makes a statement. A spray of Ajmal Silver Shade will leave you feeling confident, fresh, and ready to conquer your day with effortless style.

products.title: Ajmal Shiro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Shiro Eau De Parfum is a sharp, fresh, and energetic fragrance designed for the modern man who lives life on the go.1 The name "Shiro," meaning white in Japanese, perfectly captures its clean, crisp, and confident vibe. This perfume is an amazing mix of fresh fruits, cool watery notes, and warm woods that makes you feel instantly refreshed and ready to take on the day.

Shiro smells modern yet timeless. It has the energy of a summer morning and the confidence of a sharp suit. It’s the perfect choice for men who want a versatile, high-quality scent that works for every occasion, from the office to a casual day out. A few sprays of Ajmal Shiro will leave you smelling clean, magnetic, and effortlessly stylish.

products.title: Ajmal Kuro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Kuro is designed for the modern Indian gent who wants the punch of a designer perfume without the designer price tag. The first spray bursts open with cool bergamot and lively pepper, giving a crisp “wake‑up” feel that cuts through humidity. Just seconds later, elegant French lavender and bright geranium step in, smoothing the edges and adding a clean, shirt‑fresh vibe. Deeper down, earthy vetiver, patchouli, and a whisper of ambergris ground the scent and help it cling to skin and fabric long after sundown. Think of it as a confident handshake that turns into an all‑day friendship, easy to like, hard to forget, and perfect for the office, college campus, or a late‑night drive.

products.title: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum was launched in 2013 by Ajmal fragrance house that is based in UAE as a fresh aquatic scent with a touch of citric and floral notes. It opens with Citric bergamot, flowery lavender and fruity watermelon; with time it diffuses off the top notes and the heart notes of Lotus and jasmine becomes more prominent and finally it has a soft and musky drydown with its amber, musk and sandalwood notes.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Blue Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Turathi Blue is a crisp, fresh, and uplifting scent crafted for the modern man. It starts with a burst of zesty bergamot and mandarin, creating an energizing first impression. The scent then drifts into warm amber, entwined with woody nuances, before finally resting on a base of smooth musk and patchouli with a touch of spice. Ideal for everyday wear, it is both refined and approachable with a touch of Middle Eastern richness.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense EDP Spray is a rich and masculine fragrance with a deep, contemporary and smoky character balanced by fruity freshness. The perfume creates a unique scent that lasts all day, smoothly blending crisp apple and bergamot with warm saffron notes and dark musky undertones.

products.title: Afnan 9pm Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9pm Eau de Parfum is one of the most admired amber vanilla fragrances for men, launched in 2020. The scent is a popular choice amongst fragrance enthusiasts, one sharing similarity with Jean Paul Gaultier’s Ultra Male. The perfume’s bold and seductive composition featuring a rich blend of sweet, spicy and warm notes makes it ideal for evening wear, romantic date nights and cooler seasons of the year.

products.title: Acqua Di Parma Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Acqua di Parma Leather EDP for men and women is a sophisticated and luxurious evening perfume with a rich citrusy opening with Brazilian orange, Sicilian lemon, and raspberry top notes; aromatic and leather-balancing red thyme, rose, petitgrain, and honeysuckle heart notes; and a polished base of leather, cedarwood, and guaiac wood. It was formulated by François Demachy in 2019. 

It is highly praised among the fragrance community as a highly refined and exceptional blend of notes with a distinguished quality and satisfactory projection & sillage.
